item.title: President Lee: "We Must Not Fall Into the Trap of Populist Austerity That Deceives the People" (이 대통령 “국민 눈 속이는 포퓰리즘적 긴축재정론 함정 안 돼”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 12th, "There are voices in some parts of society that demand austerity like a repetitive refrain, but these are essentially irresponsible calls that disregard the suffering of the people." (이재명 대통령이 12일 “마치 돌림노래처럼 긴축을 강요하는 목소리가 사회 일각에 존재하는데, 사실상 민생 고통을 수수방관하라는 무책임한 목소리”라고 말했다.)

During a Cabinet meeting presided over at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, "It has been confirmed through research results that active and strategic fiscal management can provide real momentum to the people's economy." He added, "The livelihood recovery coupons issued last year had the effect of increasing sales for local small business owners by an additional 430,000 won per 1 million won worth of consumer coupons." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “재정의 적극적이고 전략적 운용이 민생경제에 실질적 동력을 제공할 수 있다는 점이 연구결과로 확인됐다”며 “지난해 지급된 민생회복쿠폰이 지역 소상공인 매출을 소비쿠폰 100만원당 추가로 43만원을 늘리는 효과를 거뒀다”고 말했다.)

President Lee then remarked, "When thrift was a virtue, we didn't spend, we saved, we tightened our belts, but now it's an era where consumption is a virtue." He emphasized, "This is a society struggling because money isn't circulating. In such times, the government's role is to enable economic circulation through investment." He also noted, "There has been an announcement from international institutions that our actual debt, excluding nominal debt, is only about 10% of GDP. This shows that our national debt structure is superior to that of any other country." (이 대통령은 그러면서 “절약이 미덕일 때는 안 쓰고 아끼고, 저축하고, 허리띠를 졸라맸지만, 지금은 소비가 미덕인 시대”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “돈이 안 돌아서 문제인 사회인데, 이럴 때는 투자를 통해서 경제가 순환하도록 하는 게 정부 역할”이라며 “명목상의 채무 말고 실질적인 채무는 국내총생산(GDP) 대비 10% 정도라는 국제기관의 발표도 있었다. 다른 어느 나라보다 국가채무 구조가 우량하다는 것”이라고 강조했다.)

President Lee stressed that actively using fiscal policy to boost economic growth and GDP itself would enlarge the denominator, thereby actually lowering the national debt ratio. He said, "If the potential growth rate and actual growth are enhanced, the tax revenue base expands, and the debt ratio decreases over the long term, realizing a virtuous cycle that thickens the growth platform. We must not fall into the trap of populist austerity theory that deceives the people." (이 대통령은 적극적 재정을 통해 경제성장률과 국내총생산 자체를 높이면 분모가 커져 국가부채비율이 오히려 떨어진다고 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “잠재성장률과 성장이 제고되면 세입기반이 확대되고 부채비율이 장기적으로 낮아져 경제성장판이 더욱 두터워지는 선순환 구조를 실현할 수 있다”며 “국민 눈을 속이는 포퓰리즘적 긴축재정론 함정에 빠져선 안 된다”고 말했다.)

Furthermore, President Lee stated, "The government should focus its capabilities on laying the foundation for a great leap forward in the national economy through active fiscal policy." He added, "I urge you to prepare the economic growth strategy for the second half of the year and draft next year's budget based on this stance." (아울러 이 대통령은 “정부는 적극 재정을 통해 국민경제 대도약의 발판을 닦는데 역량을 집중해야겠다”며 “이런 기조를 바탕으로 하반기 경제성장 전략 수립과 내년도 예산편성에 임해주길 당부한다”고 말했다.)

Reporters: Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr, Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Lee Jae-myung Claims Injustice? Jo Joo-bin and Park Wang-yeol Would Also Say They're Wronged." (장동혁 “이재명이 억울해? 조주빈·박왕열도 억울하다 할 판”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, criticized the "Special Investigation into Alleged Fabricated Prosecutions" bill pushed by the Democratic Party of Korea, bringing up "Nth Room's Jo Joo-bin." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 더불어민주당이 추진하는 ‘조작 기소 특검범’을 비판하며 ‘엔(N)번방 조주빈’을 거론했다.)

On the 12th, on Facebook, omitting the presidential title, Jang claimed, "If Lee Jae-myung is a wronged victim, then who in South Korea deserves to go to jail? Even Nth Room's Jo Joo-bin and drug kingpin Park Wang-yeol would say they're wronged." (장 대표는 12일 페이스북에서 대통령 호칭을 생략한 채 “이재명이 억울한 피해자면 대한민국에 감옥 갈 사람이 누가 있나”라며 “엔번방 조주빈도, 마약왕 박왕열도 억울하다 할 판이다”라고 주장했다.)

He mentioned violent criminals like Jo Joo-bin to criticize the Democratic Party's bill, which seeks to appoint a special counsel to investigate alleged fabricated investigations and prosecutions by the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, including the prosecution, National Intelligence Service, and the Board of Audit and Inspection. (민주당이 추진하는 ‘윤석열 정권 검찰청, 국가정보원, 감사원 등의 조작수사·조작기소 등 의혹의 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률안’을 비판하기 위해 조주빈 등 강력 범죄자들을 언급한 것이다.)

Jang shared an article where Choo Mi-ae, the Democratic Party's candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor, said about this special law, "If the investigation reveals the truth of the fabricated prosecutions clearly, it's only natural to restore the honor of those who were wronged." He commented, "The 'prosecutorial revocation special law' is now called 'restoring the honor of wronged victims.' Typical of the 'Ggaddle [Lee Jae-myung supporters] pick.'" (장 대표는 민주당 추미애 경기지사 후보가 이 특검법에 대해 “수사를 통해 조작 기소 실체가 명명백백히 밝혀진다고 하면 억울하게 피해를 본 분들의 명예를 회복시키는 게 당연”하다고 말한 내용의 기사를 공유하며 “‘공소취소 특검’이 ‘억울한 피해자의 명예 회복’이란다. ‘개딸픽’답다”고도 말했다.)

Jang also said, "The conservative mother Choo Mi-ae is back. Was she afraid of being pushed aside by stepmother Seo Young-kyo?" Following his remarks about Choo, Jang has recently referred to Seo Young-kyo, a Democratic Party lawmaker who succeeded Choo as head of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, as "stepmother." (장 대표는 “보수의 어머니 추미애가 돌아왔다. 새엄마 서영교에게 밀리기 싫었나?”라며 이같이 말했다. 장 대표는 추 후보에 이어 국회 법제사법위원회 위원장을 맡은 서영교 민주당 의원을 최근 ‘새엄마’라고 칭하고 있다.)

Jang further claimed, "What if Choo Mi-ae becomes Gyeonggi Province governor? The Ggaddle will take all the good positions, and the money meant for residents will be funneled to leftist groups," adding, "She might lead the charge to send Samsung's semiconductor plants in Yongin to Saemangeum." (장 대표는 이어 “혹시라도 추미애가 경기도지사 되면? 좋은 자리 개딸들이 다 차지하고, 도민에게 쓸 돈 좌파 단체에 갖다 바치겠지”라며 “용인 삼성 반도체를 새만금으로 보내자고 앞장설지도 모르겠다”고 주장하기도 했다.)

The People Power Party is pushing the "prosecutorial revocation" issue to the forefront, including plans to form a "Prosecutorial Revocation Response Task Force" within its central election campaign committee for the June 3 local elections. (국민의힘은 6·3 지방선거 중앙선거대책위원회에 ‘공소 취소 대응 태스크포스(TF)’를 구성하기로 하는 등 ‘공소 취소’ 이슈를 전면에 내세우려 하고 있다.)

Meanwhile, Jo Joo-bin was convicted for coercing female victims, including children and adolescents, into producing sexually exploitative videos and selling and distributing them via the Telegram "Doctor Room." In October 2021, the Supreme Court confirmed his 42-year prison sentence. In February 2024, he received an additional four months for forcible molestation, and in December 2023, an additional five years for sexually assaulting a minor. (한편, 조주빈은 아동·청소년을 포함한 여성 피해자들을 협박해 성 착취 영상물을 제작하고 이를 텔레그램 ‘박사방’을 통해 판매·유포한 혐의 등으로 기소돼 2021년 10월 대법원에서 징역 42년을 확정받았다. 2024년 2월엔 강제추행 혐의로 추가 기소된 건에서 징역 4개월을, 지난해 12월엔 미성년자 성폭행 혐의로 추가 기소된 사건에서 징역 5년을 더 확정받기도 했다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Pro-Han Dong-hoon Lawmaker Han Ji-ah Criticizes Han: "Must Uphold Principles Even in a Hurry" Over Appointment of Jeong Hyeong-geun (친한계 한지아, 한동훈에 “정형근 위촉, 급해도 선 지켜야” 쓴소리)
item.description:
As controversy swirls around independent candidate Han Dong-hoon for the Busan North District A by-election appointing former Grand National Party lawmaker Jeong Hyeong-geun, a former public security prosecutor suspected of involvement in multiple 'torture investigations,' as the chair of his campaign support committee, pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmaker Han Ji-ah of the People Power Party stated, "There are principles and lines that must be upheld even in times of urgency." <<> Appearing on MBC's "News Today" on the 12th, Lawmaker Han said she was "unaware in advance and had no discussion at all" regarding the appointment of former lawmaker Jeong. "As politicians in South Korea, there are principles and lines we must uphold, and these must be maintained not only when convenient but also when urgent," she stated. "To achieve that, more must be done by those around (candidate Han), and that includes politician Han Ji-ah," she added, concluding, "I will try harder." <<> When asked by the host if she judged the appointment of former lawmaker Jeong to be inappropriate, Lawmaker Han avoided a direct answer, saying, "The ultimate goal of democracy is human rights," and reiterated, "I will strive to ensure healthier voices come from the surroundings." In response to a question about whether she plans to advise candidate Han to revoke Jeong's appointment, she replied, "If necessary, I should convey (my opinion)." <<> Former lawmaker Jeong, who serves as the chair of candidate Han's campaign support committee, was seconded to the National Security Planning Agency (then Korea's intelligence agency) during his time as a prosecutor in the 1980s, where he held the position of director of the anti-communist investigation bureau. During this period, allegations have been raised that he directly tortured or ordered the torture of several individuals involved in the democratization movement, including the late former lawmaker Kim Geun-tae, known as the "godfather of the democratization movement," and former lawmaker Seo Gyeong-won. After democratization, the prosecution disclosed that the involvement of the late "torture technician" Lee Geun-an in the investigation of former lawmaker Kim was based on former lawmaker Jeong's instructions to "thoroughly extract the truth, even if it means beating it out of him." Former lawmaker Jeong denies all involvement in the torture. <<> Former lawmaker Jeong also argued that the December 3 emergency martial law declaration "does not constitute insurrection." Appearing on a December 13, 2024 broadcast of the Free Constitution Broadcasting YouTube channel, Jeong stated, "It's not insurrection; this is the president's abuse of authority. The president, in his own judgment, intended to do well, but the conditions were insufficient or went a bit too far. Applying insurrection charges is something unthinkable. I believe it is a grave mistake to claim it constitutes insurrection." <<> As the controversy grew, candidate Han, in a interview on MBC Radio's "Kim Jong-bae's Focus" on the 7th, said, "He received many recommendations from local residents and holds great trust within the region. It shows that even those with a strong conservative leaning recognize that Han Dong-hoon's intent to rebuild conservatism after crossing the sea of martial law and impeachment aligns with their views." He also stated, "This is my election, not an election for the campaign support committee chair." <<> Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (한동훈 부산 북갑 보궐선거 무소속 후보가 여러 차례 ‘고문 수사’ 관여 의혹을 받았던 공안검사 출신 정형근 전 한나라당 의원을 후원회장으로 위촉해 논란인 가운데, ‘친한동훈계’ 한지아 국민의힘 의원이 “급할 때도 지켜야 될 원칙과 선이 있다”는 입장을 밝혔다.)

item.title: President Lee Targets 'Sangnoksu' from Card Crisis: "20–30 Years of Debt Collection... Find a Solution" (이 대통령, 카드대란 ‘상록수’ 겨냥 “20~30년 추심… 해결방법 찾아라”)
item.description:
<<>> President Lee Jae-myung criticized 'Sangnoksu', a private bad bank established during the 2003 credit card crisis, saying, "The card crisis was 20 to 30 years ago. How are people supposed to live if debt collection continues even now?" ()

At a Cabinet meeting presided over at the presidential office on the 12th, President Lee stated, "Is it in line with the public's moral sentiment that interest has increased 10 to 20 times and people must sell even the last sprout of a bean sprout in their home to pay it off?" He added, "If necessary, we must find a solution, even through legislation." Sangnoksu, a private bad bank, is a special purpose company established in 2003 by major domestic banks and credit card companies. It took over non-performing loans from the card crisis and has continued collecting debts from long-term delinquent borrowers. On that day, a media outlet reported that Sangnoksu's investors were asked to sell their long-term delinquent bonds to the government's bad bank, the 'New Leap Fund' (operated by the Korea Asset Management Corporation), but took a passive stance. As a result, as of the end of last year, support for rehabilitation regarding bonds worth approximately 700 billion won for about 90,000 individuals had not been provided. The investors have also received about 42 billion won in dividends over the past five years. ( 이재명 대통령이 2003년 카드대란 당시 설립된 민간 배드뱅크 ‘상록수’를 겨냥해 “카드 사태가 20~30년이 지났는데, 지금까지 (추심하면) 사람은 어떻게 살라는 거냐”고 말했다.)

President Lee said, "They are not loan sharks. Financial institutions operate using the government's authority to issue currency, and they benefit from licensing and approval systems. They must also bear public regulation and public burdens. The attitude of enjoying benefits while avoiding burdens to the end is not right." He then instructed, "We can't force it, but look into possible alternatives." <<> In response, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won said, "On the surface, it's a corporation formed by multiple institutions, so they claim they need unanimous shareholder consent. But in the end, profit considerations are behind this, making them passive in participating in the agreement. Since the New Leap Fund itself was a kind of social consensus, financial institutions should also participate." ( 이 대통령은 12일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “(이자가) 10~20배 늘어나서 끝까지 집안 콩나물 한 개라도 팔아서 갚아야 한다는 게 국민적 도덕감정에 맞냐”며 “필요하면 입법해서라도 해결방법을 찾아야 한다”고 말했다. 민간 배드뱅크인 ‘상록수’는 2003년 국내 대형 은행·카드사들이 설립한 특수목적법인으로, 카드대란 당시 발생한 부실채권을 넘겨받은 뒤 장기 연체자들을 상대로 추심을 이어왔다. 이날 한 언론은 상록수 출자사들이 장기 연체채권을 정부 배드뱅크 새도약기금(한국자산관리공사 운용)으로 매각하라는 협조 요청을 받았지만 소극적인 입장을 취하면서 지난해 말 기준 약 9만명의 채권(7천억원규모)에 대한 회생 지원이 이뤄지지 못한 것으로 파악됐다고 보도했다. 출자사들은 최근 5년간 420억원가량 배당도 받았다.)

Reported by Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 “사채업자도 아니고 금융기관들이 정부 발권력을 이용해 영업하는 측면도 있고, 면허나 인가제도를 통해 혜택을 보는 측면이 있다”며 “공적규제나 공적부담도 해야 한다. 혜택은 누리면서 부담은 끝까지 안하겠다는 태도는 옳지 않다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “억지로는 못하겠지만, 가능한 대안이 있는지 알아보라”고 지시했다. )

item.title: President Lee: "School Uniform Price Fixing Is an Old Injustice… Must Be Harshly Sanctioned" (이 대통령 “교복담합은 오래된 적폐… 세게 제재해야”)
item.description:
<<>> President Lee Jae-myung said on the 12th regarding the issue of school uniform price fixing, "We need to sanction them strongly, like we do with corporations, so they never think of colluding again." ()

During a Cabinet meeting chaired at the Blue House, President Lee stated, "The school uniform price-fixing issue is one of the oldest injustices," adding, "A fine of 10 million won seems completely ineffective." He further remarked, "If they gain illicit profits and get caught, it's just a break-even, but if they don't get caught, they profit. That shouldn't happen. For example, if the illicit gain is 10 million won, I believe the fine should significantly exceed that amount." ( 이재명 대통령이 12일 교복담합 문제와 관련해 “기업들 하듯이 세게 (제재)해서 다시는 담합 생각을 못 하게 만들어야 한다”고 말했다. )

President Lee also told Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin, "How about posting the nationwide school uniform situation and prices on the education office website? I think enabling comparisons of uniform prices is the most important thing." ( 이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “교복담합 문제는 아주 오래된 적폐 중 하나”라며 “(과징금을) 1000만원 해가지고는 아무 효과가 없을 것 같다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “부당이득을 취다가 걸리면 본전이고, 안 걸리면 (이익이) 남고 그러면 안 된다”며 “예를 들어 1000만원이 부당이익 수준인데 (과징금이) 그것을 현저히 초과해야 한다고 생각한다”고 덧붙였다. )

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 최교진 교육부 장관에게 “(교육청 누리집에) 전국 교복 상황, 가격을 공지해주면 어떠냐”며 “제가 보기에 (교복 가격을) 비교하게 하는 게 제일 중요하다”라고 말했다. )

item.title: [News Dive] ‘Yacht Party’ Allegations: Only Kim Keon-hee Found Innocent ([뉴스 다이브] ‘선상 파티’ 의혹, 김건희만 무혐의)

item.title: President Lee expresses sorrow over death of elementary school student at Juwangsan: "Such unfortunate accidents should not happen" (이 대통령, 주왕산 초등생 사망에 “안타까워…이런 불행한 사고 없어야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung asked his Cabinet members to "pay more attention so that unfortunate accidents like this do not occur in the future" regarding the discovery of a missing elementary school student who died after visiting Juwangsan National Park in Cheongsong, North Gyeongsang Province, with his family. <<> President Lee expressed his condolences after hearing related reports during a closed-door Cabinet meeting presided over at the presidential office on the 12th, according to Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung. <<> Earlier that day, in his opening remarks at the Cabinet meeting combined with an emergency economic review meeting, President Lee mentioned that the missing elementary school student had not been found for three days and said, "I ask that all available capabilities be mobilized for the search." He stated, "Ensuring that the missing child can quickly return to the arms of their family is an important duty of the state," and also asked Acting National Police Agency Commissioner Yoo Jae-sung about the number of search personnel deployed. When Acting Commissioner Yoo replied that 281 personnel had been mobilized, President Lee responded, "Isn't that too few?" and instructed, "Mobilize as much (personnel) as possible and thoroughly search everything. I hope swift measures are taken." <<> Police discovered the body of Kang, a sixth-grade elementary school student, near the summit of Juwangsan's main peak at around 10:13 a.m. on the 12th. Kang had visited a temple at Juwangsan with his family on the 10th, set off alone toward the main peak for a hike, and then went missing. <<> Shim Woo-sam, Reporter wu32@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 가족과 함께 경북 청송 주왕산국립공원을 찾았다가 실종된 초등학생이 끝내 숨진 채 발견된 것과 관련해 “앞으로는 이런 불행한 사고가 나지 않게 더 신경 쓰면 좋겠다”고 국무위원들에게 당부했다.)

item.title: Cho Hyun: “Debris of aircraft that struck M/T Mu Na will soon arrive in South Korea” … Precision investigation by Ministry of National Defense (조현 “나무호 타격 비행체 잔해, 곧 한국 도착”…국방부서 정밀 조사)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Hyun stated that the debris of the aircraft that struck a South Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz will be brought to South Korea and subjected to a precise investigation by the Ministry of National Defense and others. (조현 외교부 장관이 호르무즈해협에 있던 한국 선박을 타격한 비행체의 잔해를 국내로 가져와 국방부 등에서 정밀 조사할 것이라고 말했다.)

Minister Cho said on the 12th, “The debris will arrive (in South Korea) soon,” adding, “The forensic examination will involve relevant specialized research institutes.” However, it is not yet clear when the aircraft debris will depart from Dubai, United Arab Emirates (UAE), and arrive in South Korea. (조 장관은 12일 “(비행체) 잔해는 곧 (한국으로) 도착할 것”이라며 “감식을 맡은, 관련 전문성이 있는 연구소 등에서 함께 할 것”이라고 말했다. 다만 비행체 잔해가 언제 아랍에미리트(UAE) 두바이를 출발해 한국에 도착할지는 아직 분명하지 않다.)

A Foreign Ministry official said on the same day, “To ensure the accuracy of the investigation into the aircraft engine debris, we are pushing forward with a plan to bring it into the country for analysis by a specialized institution,” but added that the aircraft debris remains in Dubai. The official stated, “There may be procedures related to its local export.” It is known that the debris will be brought into the country via diplomatic pouch for safe storage and swift investigation. (외교부 당국자는 이날 “비행체 엔진 잔해 조사의 정확성을 기하기 위해 국내로 들여와 전문기관에서 분석하는 방안을 추진 중”이라면서도 아직 비행체는 두바이 현지에 있다고 말했다. 이 당국자는 “현지 반출과 관련한 절차가 있을 수 있다”고 말했다. 잔해는 안전한 보관과 신속한 조사를 위해 외교 행낭을 통해 국내로 들여오는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Once the aircraft debris arrives in South Korea, the professional forensic examination is expected to be conducted primarily by the Ministry of National Defense. (비행체 잔해가 한국에 도착하면, 전문적인 감식은 국방부 중심으로 이뤄질 것으로 보인다.)

Regarding this aircraft as part of a weapons system, it is reported that the Ministry of National Defense’s affiliated research institute, the Agency for Defense Development (ADD), will identify the exact model and physical dimensions of the aircraft. Deputy Spokesperson of the Ministry of National Defense, Lee Kyung-ho, stated during a regular briefing that day, “The government will support the investigation activities.” (이 비행체를 무기체계의 일부로 보고, 국방부 산하 연구소인 국방과학연구소(ADD) 등에서 정확한 기종과 비행체의 물리적 크기 등을 파악할 것으로 전해졌다. 이경호 국방부 부대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 “정부 차원에서 조사 활동을 지원할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Some claim that this aircraft is a Shahed drone, developed by Iran. The government plans to proceed with a precise investigation while keeping all other possibilities, such as anti-ship missiles, open. Minister Cho Hyun said that day, “It is difficult to make a hasty (initial judgment).” A Foreign Ministry official also emphasized, “Until the investigation is conducted, we cannot determine the type, model, or the entity behind the attack.” (일부에서는 이 비행체가 이란이 자체 개발한 샤헤드 드론이라는 주장이 나오고 있다. 정부는 대함미사일 등 다른 가능성을 모두 열어두고 정밀 조사를 진행할 예정이다. 조현 장관은 이날 “섣불리 (초기 판단을) 하기 어렵다”고 말했다. 외교부 당국자도 “조사가 이뤄지기 전까지는 비행체 종류, 기종, 공격 주체를 단정할 수 없다”고 강조했다.)

As opinions among experts remain divided over whether the aircraft is a drone or an anti-ship missile, the government intends to focus on identifying the exact model of the aircraft based on the engine debris collected at the scene, while also confirming the entity responsible for the attack. (비행체가 드론인지 대함미사일인지 전문가들 사이에서도 의견이 분분한 가운데 정부는 현장에서 수거한 비행체 엔진 잔해 등을 토대로 비행체의 정확한 기종을 파악하는 데 주력하면서 타격의 주체까지 확인하겠다는 방침이다.)

Although multiple circumstances point to Iran’s potential involvement in this attack, the government continues to emphasize a cautious stance without specifying the entity behind the attack. It appears that the government will first secure clear evidence regarding the entity behind the attack through a precise forensic examination, and then issue its official position, including protests and demands for an apology. This is because it must consider factors such as diplomatic relations with Iran, whether to participate in the U.S.-proposed Maritime Freedom Initiative (MFC), and the safety of the 25 South Korean vessels still stranded in the Strait of Hormuz. (여러 정황이 이번 공격에 이란이 관련되어 있을 가능성을 가리키고 있는 가운데, 정부는 공격 주체를 특정하지 않고 신중한 입장을 계속 강조하고 있다. 일단 정밀 감식을 통해 공격 주체에 관한 명확한 증거를 확보한 뒤 항의와 사과 요구 등 정부 입장을 내놓을 것으로 보인다. 이란과의 외교 관계, 미국이 제안한 해양자유구상(MFC) 참여 여부, 호르무즈해협에 여전히 발이 묶여 있는 한국 선박 25척의 안전 문제 등을 모두 고려할 수밖에 없기 때문이다.)

The Foreign Ministry announced that on the 10th, First Vice Minister Park Yoon-joo summoned Iranian Ambassador to South Korea Saeed Koozechi to the ministry headquarters and provided a detailed explanation of the government’s investigation results, indicating that the M/T Mu Na was attacked twice, and that Ambassador Koozechi stated he would faithfully report this to his home country. However, it is known that there has been no particular response from Iran regarding the South Korean government’s investigation results so far. (외교부는 지난 10일 박윤주 1차관이 쿠제치 주한이란대사를 청사로 불러 나무호가 2차례 공격을 받았다는 정부 조사 결과를 자세하게 설명했고, 쿠제치 대사는 본국에 충실하게 보고하겠다고 했다고 밝혔다. 하지만 우리 정부의 조사 결과에 대해 아직까지 이란 쪽의 특별한 반응은 없는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il stated during a regular briefing that day, “Until the entity behind the attack is identified, we intend to refrain from mentioning any specific country,” adding, “The government will continue communication with Iran regarding the M/T Mu Na and will also address the safe passage and security assurance of our vessels in the strait.” (박일 외교부 대변인은 이날 정례 브리핑에서 “공격 주체가 식별되기 전까지는 특정 국가에 대한 언급은 삼가고자 한다”면서 “정부는 앞으로도 이란 측과 나무호 관련 소통을 계속할 것이고 해협 내에 있는 우리 선박의 안전 통항과, 안전 보장에 대해서도 챙겨나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Foreign Ministry "Discussing Visit to Korea by Ukrainian Foreign Minister"... Likely to Discuss North Korean Prisoners of War (외교부 “우크라 외교장관 방한 협의 중”…북한군 포로 논의할 듯)
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry announced on the 12th that it is coordinating a visit schedule for Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha to South Korea. Although the specific timing of the visit has not been determined, it is reported that it is highly likely to take place in June. If the South Korea-Ukraine foreign ministers' meeting is held, the issue of repatriation of North Korean prisoners of war may be discussed as a current concern. (안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교부 장관이 한국을 방문하는 일정을 조율 중이라고 외교부가 12일 밝혔다. 구체적인 방한 시기는 정해지지 않았지만 6월 중 이뤄질 가능성이 높은 것으로 알려졌다. 한-우크라이나 외교장관 회담이 열리면 북한군 포로 송환 문제가 현안으로 논의될 가능성이 있다.)

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Il stated at a briefing that day, "We are discussing the visit of the Ukrainian Foreign Minister with the Ukrainian side," adding, "If the visit takes place, there will be discussions on overall bilateral relations, and naturally, there will also be discussions on the issue of North Korean prisoners of war." (박일 외교부 대변인은 이날 브리핑에서 “우크라이나 외교장관 방한 관련해 우크라이나측과 협의 중”이라면서, “방한이 이루어지게 되면 양국 관계 전반에 대한 논의가 이루어질 것이고, 당연히 북한 포로 문제에 대해서도 논의가 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Spokesperson Park explained, "The government will continue to make efforts, in line with humanitarian principles and international law, to ensure that North Korean prisoners of war can come to South Korea according to their free will," and added, "South Korea and Ukraine share the recognition, through several rounds of high-level consultations, that the issue of North Korean prisoners of war should be resolved in accordance with international law and humanitarian principles." (박 대변인은 “정부는 인도주의 원칙 및 국제법에 따라서 북한군 포로들의 자유의사에 따른 한국행이 이루어질 수 있도록 지속해서 노력을 해 나갈 것”이라면서, “한국과 우크라이나 간에는 수차례에 걸친 고위급 협의를 통해서 북한군 포로 문제가 국제법과 인도주의 원칙에 따라서 해결되어야 한다는 인식을 같이하고 있다”고 설명했다.)

Two North Korean soldiers, who were deployed to the Kursk region in October 2024 for combat and captured alive by Ukrainian forces, have expressed their intention to defect to South Korea through various channels, including delivering handwritten letters to South Korean civic groups. The government has previously stated its position that it clearly regards them as nationals under the Constitution and, if they wish to come to South Korea, it will accept them and provide necessary protection and support in accordance with relevant laws and regulations. (2024년 10월 쿠르스크 지역 전투에 투입됐다가 우크라이나군에 생포된 북한군 포로 2명은 그동안 한국 민간단체에 친필 편지를 전달하는 등 여러 경로를 통해 한국에 귀순할 의사가 있음을 밝혔다. 정부는 이들이 헌법상 국민이라는 점을 분명히 하고 한국으로 오기를 희망할 경우 이를 받아들여 관계 법령에 따라 필요한 보호와 지원을 제공할 것이라는 입장을 밝힌 바 있다.)

Earlier, Minister Cho Hyun and Minister Sybiha discussed this issue at a bilateral meeting held on the sidelines of the Group of Seven (G7) Foreign Ministers' Meeting in France last March, and agreed to cooperate in resolving the issue of North Korean prisoners of war in a manner consistent with international law and humanitarian principles. (앞서 조현 장관과 시비하 장관은 지난 3월 프랑스에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 외교장관회의를 계기로 양자 회담을 열어 이 문제를 논의하고, 북한군 포로 문제를 국제법과 인도주의 원칙에 부합하는 방향으로 해결하기 위해 협력하기로 했다.)

If Minister Sybiha visits South Korea, it is expected that, in addition to the issue of North Korean prisoners of war, topics such as trends in negotiations to end the war in Ukraine, the close ties between North Korea and Russia and the movements of dispatched North Korean soldiers, and plans for Ukraine's reconstruction will also be discussed. (시비하 장관이 방한하면 북한군 포로 문제 외에도 우크라이나 전쟁 종전 협상 동향, 북-러 밀착과 파병된 북한군의 동향, 우크라이나 재건 방안 등도 논의될 것으로 예상된다.)

item.title: Why Jang Dong-hyuk, Focusing on Yeongnam Elections Over Seoul, Is Staking His Future on the Regional Vote (수도권 패스하고 영남 선거 사활 거는 장동혁, 왜?)
item.description:
<<>> Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party (PPP), is deeply committed to winning over the support of the Yeongnam region (the southeastern area covering Daegu, Busan, and surrounding provinces) as the June 3 local elections approach with about 20 days to go. This move is also interpreted as an effort to secure his leadership position after the elections. ()

On the afternoon of the 12th, Jang attended the launch ceremony and strategy meeting of the Gyeongbuk Provincial Party Election Committee, held in Daegu. At the event, Jang emphasized, "The voter sentiment gathered here in Gyeongbuk will become a gust, then a typhoon, covering the entire Republic of Korea," adding, "The wind of Gyeongbuk will become the wind of the People Power Party and the wind of the Republic of Korea." Following visits to Busan and Daegu on the 10th and Ulsan the previous day, Jang has been focusing on consolidating conservative support by conducting a three-day consecutive schedule in the Yeongnam region. <<> Meanwhile, there are ongoing moves to organize events that exclude Jang, particularly in the Seoul metropolitan area. The Seoul Party chapter did not invite Jang or other party leadership to the campaign committee launch ceremony, following a similar pattern from last month's Victory Resolution Rally. Oh Se-hoon, the Seoul mayoral candidate, distanced himself by stating at a Korea Press Foundation debate the previous day, "I appreciate his willingness to help, but it doesn't seem absolutely necessary right now." In contrast, Incheon mayoral candidate Yoo Jeong-bok invited Jang to his camp's opening ceremony, but Jang declined citing scheduling conflicts in Gyeongbuk. <<> Within the party leadership, there are already murmurs that merely holding onto the Yeongnam region would constitute a respectable performance. A party leadership official defended Jang's efforts, saying, "Even Daegu was said to be difficult, but if we can win Busan too, isn't that a decent outcome?" <<> On the other hand, Park Jeong-ha, a lawmaker aligned with the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, criticized the approach in an interview with MBC Radio, stating, "Now that Daegu, Gyeongbuk, Gyeongnam, and Ulsan are shaky, (after the elections, securing these areas) he might claim, 'This is thanks to me.' It's all about a 'lost but fought well' narrative." <<> Article by Jang Na-rae and Jo Hee-yeon | wing@hani.co.kr ( 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거를 20여일 앞두고 영남권 표심 다지기에 사활을 걸고 있다. 이는 지방선거 이후 당권 사수를 위한 행보로도 해석된다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Steps In to Calm Turbulent Jeonbuk Governor Race (요동치는 전북지사 판세 수습 나선 정청래)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea is putting significant effort into managing the Jeonbuk governor election. With the independent candidacy of Governor Kim Kwan-young—expelled from the party over the so-called "cash envelope scandal"—shaking up the race, the party is facing considerable headaches. (더불어민주당이 전북지사 선거전 단속에 공을 들이고 있다. 이른바 ‘돈봉투 사건’으로 당에서 제명된 김관영 지사의 무소속 출마로 선거판이 요동치자 골머리를 앓는 모습이다.)

On the 12th, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae said at the "Democratic Party Jeonnam, Gwangju, and Jeonbuk Candidate Convention" held in Gangjin, South Jeolla Province, "The reason Mount Everest is the tallest is because it sits atop the Himalayan mountain range." He added, "I hope candidates realize that the Democratic Party (like the Himalayas) is supporting them, which increases their chances of winning and garners applause and expectations from many people." This remark is interpreted as an indirect criticism of candidate Kim, who opted to run as an independent after being expelled from the party over suspicions of proxy payment for campaign expenses. Jung emphasized that Lee Won-taek, the party's Jeonbuk governor candidate, is "a proud Democratic Party candidate" and "a candidate we must ensure gets elected." <<> That same day, Democratic Party senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun appeared on Korean Broadcasting System (KBS) radio and stated, "It is a violation of party rules for Democratic Party members to assist other parties or independent candidates." A party leadership official commented, "I think the overall candidate nomination process for these local and by-elections went smoothly without major conflicts or incidents," but added, "Still, it is genuinely embarrassing to see issues arise in the Honam region, of all places." <<> Candidate Kim's camp is pushing back strongly. On the same day, Kim's election campaign committee released a statement saying, "It is Representative Jung who is ruining the Democratic Party through arrogance," and urged, "Face the reality that the public's sentiment is surging with anger over Jung Cheong-rae's party dictatorship." The committee also directed criticism at senior spokesperson Kang, calling his remarks "threatening" and questioning, "Are you truly unaware that members of our party are lining up to volunteer for our campaign, even if it means facing expulsion?" <<> Reported by Choi Ha-yeon, chy@hani.co.kr ( 정청래 민주당 대표는 12일 전남 강진에서 열린 ‘민주당 전남·광주·전북 공천자대회’에서 “에베레스트산이 제일 높은 이유는 히말라야산맥 위에 얹혀 있기 때문”이라며 “(히말라야산맥 같은) 민주당이 (후보들을) 품고 있기에 당선 가능성도 높고 많은 사람의 박수와 기대를 받고 있다 생각하길 바란다”고 말했다. 대리비 대납 의혹으로 당에서 제명된 뒤 무소속 출마를 택한 김 후보를 우회적으로 비판한 발언으로 해석된다. 정 대표는 이원택 전북지사 후보를 두고 “자랑스러운 민주당 후보”, “우리가 꼭 당선시켜야 할 후보”라고 강조했다.)

item.title: First Inter-Korean Football Exchange in Eight Years: Government Supports North Korean Cheer Squad with 3 Billion Won from Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund (8년 만의 남북 축구 교류…정부, 북한 응원단에 남북협력기금 3억원 지원)
item.description:
The government has decided to support the cheer squad for the North Korean women's football team "Naegohyang Women's Football Club," which is visiting South Korea to compete in the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League semifinals. (정부가 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스리그 준결승전 출전을 위해 남한을 방문하는 북한 여자 축구팀 ‘내고향여자축구단’ 경기 응원단을 지원하기로 했다.)

A Unification Ministry official stated on the 12th, "Considering that this event contributes to enhancing mutual understanding between the two Koreas, the government has decided to provide support from the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund for the cheer squad." The ministry approved the allocation of 300 million won through the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund Management Deliberation Committee the previous day to cover the cheering costs of civilian organizations. This includes expenses for items necessary for cheer squad activities, such as match tickets and cheering tools. (통일부 당국자는 12일 “정부는 이번 행사가 남북 상호 이해 증진에 기여한다는 점을 고려해 응원단에 남북협력기금을 지원하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 통일부는 전날 남북협력기금관리심의위원회 심의를 거쳐 3억원을 민간단체들의 응원 비용으로 지원하기로 의결했다. 경기 관람 티켓과 응원 도구 등 응원단 활동에 필요한 물품 비용이 해당한다.)

Civilian groups like the Korean Sharing Movement and the Hankyoreh Unified Culture Foundation are recruiting joint inter-Korean cheer squads, fostering an atmosphere of exchange between the two Koreas. It is reported that approximately 3,000 people have applied to join the cheer squad through these organizations. Naegohyang Women's Football Club will play the semifinal match against Suwon FC Women on the 20th. (우리민족서로돕기운동이나 한겨레통일문화재단 등 민간단체는 남북 공동 응원단을 모집하며 남북 간 교류 분위기를 만들고 있다. 단체를 통해 신청한 응원단 규모는 약 3000명 수준인 것으로 전해졌다. 내고향여자축구단은 20일 수원FC위민과 4강 경기를 치른다.)

Considering the unique nature of inter-Korean matches, the Unification Ministry and civilian organizations are expected to coordinate on the cheering methods and content. For instance, regarding cheer slogans, the Unification Ministry official noted, "There are aspects that need to be discussed with the Asian Football Confederation and the Korea Football Association," adding, "We plan to summarize and guide the organizations." This includes a recommendation to avoid using the term "North Korea" in chants. The North Korean delegation has shown sensitivity to this issue, as seen during the 2022 Hangzhou Asian Games when they objected to the media's use of "North Korea." Additionally, in line with AFC regulations prohibiting political and religious expressions within stadiums, the Korean Peninsula flag is also expected to be banned from being brought into the venue. (남북한 사이 경기의 특수성을 고려해 응원 방식과 내용 등을 두고 통일부와 민간단체의 협의도 이뤄질 전망이다. 가령 응원 구호를 두고 통일부 당국자는 “아시아축구연맹, 대한축구협회와도 협의해야 할 부분이 있다”며 “(단체에는) 정리해 안내할 계획”이라고 말했다. 구호에 ‘북한’ 호칭을 쓰지 않을 것을 권고하는 방안도 포함된다. 북한 선수단은 2022 항저우 아시안게임에서 취재진의 ‘북한’ 표현에 항의하는 등 국가 호칭 문제에 민감한 반응을 보이고 있다. 경기장 내에서 정치적·종교적 표현을 금지하는 아시아축구연맹 규정에 따라 한반도기 반입도 금지될 전망이다.)

Furthermore, Unification Minister Kim Young-ho is considering attending the match between Naegohyang Women's Football Club and Suwon FC Women in person. When asked by Archbishop Lee Yong-hoon, President of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of Korea, during a visit to the Catholic Central Council of Korea on the same day whether he would come to the soccer stadium, Minister Kim replied, "I am reviewing various options." Minister Kim also remarked, "It has been almost eight years since a Pyongyang (North Korean) team came to Suwon," adding, "Since late 2018, all civil and sports exchanges have been cut off, so the visit itself is significant." (아울러 정동영 통일부 장관도 내고향여자축구단과 수원FC위민의 경기 현장 관람을 검토하고 있다. 정 장관은 이날 한국천주교중앙협의회에서 이용훈 한국천주교주교회의 의장을 예방하며 축구 경기장에 올 것인지 묻는 이 의장에게 “여러 가지를 검토하고 있다”고 말했다. 정 장관은 “수원에 평양(북한)팀이 오는 것이 거의 8년만”이라며 “2018년 말 이후 일체 민간교류, 체육 교류가 끊어졌는데, (선수단 방남) 그 자체만으로 의미가 있다”고도 했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek: "Cooperate on OPCON Transition"...Hegseth: "Expand Role in the Strait of Hormuz" (안규백 “전작권 전환 협력을”…헤그세스 “호르무즈 역할 확대”)
item.description:
South Korean Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek and U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth met in Washington on the 11th (local time) to discuss the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON) and alliance modernization. Minister Ahn requested U.S. cooperation on the OPCON transition, while Secretary Hegseth praised South Korea as an "exemplary ally" and emphasized the need to expand the alliance's role in the Strait of Hormuz. (안규백 국방부 장관과 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방(전쟁)장관이 11일(현지시각) 미국 워싱턴에서 만나 전시작전통제권 전환과 동맹 현대화 등을 논의했다. 안 장관은 전작권 전환에 관해 미국 쪽의 협력을 요청했고, 헤그세스 장관은 한국을 ‘모범 동맹’이라고 추어올리며 호르무즈해협에서 동맹의 역할 확대 필요성을 강조했다.)

In the meeting, Minister Ahn "explained South Korea's recent efforts regarding defense budget increases, securing core military capabilities, and taking the lead in defending the Korean Peninsula," while Secretary Hegseth emphasized "the importance of adopting a realistic and practical approach in modernizing the alliance to deter threats and strengthen the ROK-U.S. combined defense posture," according to a joint press release from the two defense ministries issued the same day. (안 장관은 이 자리에서 “국방비 증액, 핵심 군사역량 확보, 한반도 방위 주도를 위한 최근 한국의 노력을 설명”했고, 헤그세스 장관은 “동맹을 현대화하는 가운데, 위협을 억제하고 한·미 연합방위태세를 강화하기 위해 현실적이고 실용적인 접근을 채택하는 것의 중요성”을 강조했다고 한·미 국방부가 이날 공동 보도자료를 내어 밝혔다.)

South Korea requested U.S. cooperation for the ongoing OPCON transition, while the U.S. focused on alliance modernization aimed at expanding strategic autonomy to counter China. The Lee Jae-myung administration aims to complete the second stage (Full Operational Capability) of the evaluation and verification process for OPCON transition within this year. Minister Ahn's visit to the U.S. took place before discussions on OPCON were concretized at the deputy-level Korea-U.S. Integrated Defense Dialogue (KIDD), set to begin on the 12th. (한국은 추진 중인 전작권 전환을 위한 미국의 협력을 요청했고, 미국은 중국 견제 목적의 전략적 자율성을 확대하기 위한 동맹 현대화에 방점을 뒀다. 이재명 정부는 올해 안에 전작권 전환을 위한 평가 및 검증 절차 중 2단계(완전운용능력) 검증을 끝내는 것을 목표로 하고 있다. 안 장관 방미는 12일부터 열릴 차관급 한·미 통합국방협의체(KIDD)에서 전작권 논의를 구체화하기 전 이뤄졌다.)

The two ministers also discussed the issue of the U.S. lifting restrictions on sharing North Korea-related information and cooperation on building nuclear-powered submarines, as agreed upon by the ROK-U.S. summit. Deputy Defense Ministry Spokesperson Lee Kyung-ho stated at a regular briefing that day, "We emphasized the importance of achieving tangible results as soon as possible regarding the introduction of nuclear submarines, as it is a summit agreement," and regarding the restrictions on information sharing, he indirectly said, "We had a comprehensive discussion on alliance issues." (두 장관은 미국의 대북 정보 제한 해제 문제와 한·미 정상 합의사항인 핵추진잠수함 건조를 위한 협력 사안도 논의했다. 이경호 국방부 부대변인은 이날 정례 브리핑에서 “핵잠 도입은 정상 합의사항인 만큼 조속히 가시적 성과를 내는 것이 중요하다는 점을 강조했다”며, 정보 공유 제한과 관련해선 “동맹 현안에 대해 포괄적으로 논의했다”고 에둘러 말했다.)

The talks also likely discussed measures to contribute to the safe passage of ships in the Strait of Hormuz. In his opening remarks, Secretary Hegseth highly praised South Korea's increased defense spending, saying, "The leadership to take primary responsibility for the security of the Korean Peninsula is very important," and added, "This demonstrates burden-sharing in the alliance." He mentioned the U.S. military operation against Iran, "Great Wrath," and expressed, "We expect partners to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with us." This is consistent with the U.S. request for South Korea to participate in the "Liberation Project" involving deploying military assets to assist merchant ship evacuations, or the "Maritime Freedom Coalition" (MFC), a coalition to resume navigation. (회담에선 호르무즈해협 내 선박의 안전한 통항에 기여하는 방안도 논의했을 것으로 보인다. 헤그세스 장관은 회담 머리발언에서 한국의 국방비 지출 확대를 높이 평가하며 “한반도 안보에 대한 주도적 책임을 지려는 리더십은 매우 중요하다”며 “이는 동맹 부담 분담을 보여주는 것”이라고 말했다. 그는 미국의 대이란 군사작전 ‘장대한 분노’를 언급하며 “파트너들이 우리와 어깨를 나란히 하기를 기대한다”고 했다. 미국이 군 자산을 투입해 상선들의 탈출을 돕는 ‘해방 프로젝트’나 통항 재개를 위한 연합체 ‘해양자유연합’(MFC) 등에 참여할 것을 요청해왔던 것과 같은 맥락이다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Lee stated, "Our position regarding contributions to passage in the Strait of Hormuz is to review and pursue phased measures," and regarding participation in the Maritime Freedom Coalition, he said, "I understand there were discussions at a general level." The defense ministry will also attend a multinational military mission meeting on passage in the Strait of Hormuz, led by the U.K. and France, scheduled for later that evening. (이 부대변인은 “우리는 (호르무즈해협 통항 기여 부분에선) 단계적인 방안을 검토해 추진한다는 입장”이라며 해양자유연합 참여와 관련해선 “원론적인 수준의 논의가 있었던 것으로 안다”고 했다. 국방부는 이날 밤 열리는 영국·프랑스 주도 호르무즈해협 통항 관련 다국적 군사 임무 회의에도 참석한다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji, Washington / Correspondent Kim Won-cheol penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자, 워싱턴/김원철 특파원 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam running for Pyeongtaek-eul: “Innovation Party starts its top committee with ‘Yong-morning’ … they closed the door on unification first.” (평택을 출마 김용남 “혁신당, ‘용모닝’으로 최고위 시작…단일화 문 먼저 닫아”)
item.description:
“They say the Cho Kuk Innovation Party’s top committee meetings now start with ‘Yong-morning’ (meaning criticizing Kim Yong-nam every morning). I wish they would stop paying attention to me.” (“요즘 조국혁신당 최고위원회의는 ‘용모닝’(아침마다 김용남을 비판한다는 뜻)으로 시작한다더라. 내게 관심을 좀 꺼줬으면 좋겠다.”)

Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, strongly criticized his rival, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, in an interview held at a café in Sangam-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul on the 11th. He said, “Candidate Cho’s side was the one that first closed the door on unification.” Kim stated that if elected, his top priorities would be establishing a new KTX Gyeonggi Southern Station and resolving the chronic traffic problems in downtown Pyeongtaek. Kim, a former member of the Saenuri Party (the predecessor of the People Power Party), switched his party affiliation to the Reform Party in January 2024 before joining the Democratic Party ahead of the last presidential election. (6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 나서는 김용남 더불어민주당 후보는 지난 11일 서울 마포구 상암동 한 카페에서 한 인터뷰에서 경쟁자인 조국 조국혁신당 후보를 강하게 비판했다. 그는 “단일화의 문은 조 후보 쪽이 먼저 닫아버렸다”고 했다. 김 후보는 자신이 당선되면 케이티엑스(KTX) 경기남부역사 신설과 고질적인 평택 시내 교통 문제를 최우선적으로 해결하겠다고 했다. 새누리당(국민의힘 전신) 출신인 김 후보는 2024년 1월 개혁신당으로 당적을 옮긴 뒤 지난 대선 때 민주당에 입당했다.)

―Why should it be ‘Kim Yong-nam’ for Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul? (―왜 경기 평택을에 ‘김용남’이어야 하는가?)

“In an election landscape where Candidate Cho and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon are expected to take a significant portion of the progressive vote, I judged that I, who have support bases across different camps by advocating for real estate tax relief and such, am the right person to expand support among centrist voters.” (“조국 후보와 김재연 진보당 후보가 진보 성향 표를 상당 부분 가져갈 것으로 보이는 선거 지형에서 부동산 세제 완화 등을 주장하며 진영을 넘어선 지지 기반을 갖춘 제가 중도층 표심까지 확장할 적임자라고 판단했다.”)

―If elected, what is the first task you will pursue? (―당선되면 가장 먼저 추진할 과제는?)

“Establishing a new KTX Gyeonggi Southern Station and pushing for an early extension of the Shinansan Line are needed, but the traffic problem in the city center is truly severe. There are also many areas that aren't properly supplied with tap water or city gas. Equipping the overall urban infrastructure is an urgent priority.” (“케이티엑스 경기남부역사 신설, 신안산선 연장 사업 조기 추진도 필요한데, 시내 교통 문제가 정말 심각하다. 상수도나 도시가스가 제대로 공급되지 않는 곳도 많다. 전반적인 도시 인프라를 갖추는 게 급선무다.”)

―On the 11th, you apologized for your 2015 remarks, where you said regarding the Sewol Ferry disaster, ‘It’s urgent to review the budget for the Sewol Special Investigation Committee, which only wastes taxpayer money,’ and for your history of activities in former President Yoon Suk Yeol’s presidential campaign. (―지난 11일 세월호 참사 관련해 “국민 세금만 낭비하는 세월호 특조위 관련 예산을 점검하는 게 시급하다”고 한 2015년 발언과 윤석열 전 대통령 대선 캠프 활동 이력에 대해 사과했다.)

“My remarks were about the budget spending of the Sewol Special Investigation Committee. However, I saw a YouTube video from someone presumed to be a bereaved family member and thought that from their perspective, my remarks could be interpreted differently. The Yoon Suk Yeol administration ended as a failure more than any other administration. I thought I should also apologize for having been involved in the creation of that administration.” (“제 발언은 세월호 특조위 예산 사용과 관련된 것이었다. 그러나 유족으로 추정되는 분의 유튜브 영상을 보게 됐고 유족 입장에서는 제 발언을 다르게 받아들일 수 있겠다 생각했다. 윤석열 정권은 그 어느 정권보다도 실패로 끝났다. 그 정권 탄생에 관여했던 것도 사과드려야 한다고 생각했다.”)

―Candidate Cho and the Innovation Party say, ‘Candidate Cho better aligns with the Democratic Party’s reformist line,’ and call you ‘prosecutor-like.’ (―조 후보와 혁신당은 ‘조 후보가 민주당 개혁노선에 더 부합한다’, 김 후보를 두고 ‘검사스럽다’고 한다.)

“Does someone who has never been a Democratic Party member for even a single day have the right to say such things? What has (Candidate Cho) actually done, having been pardoned through a Liberation Day amnesty after the government was launched, to help the Lee Jae-myung administration? Claiming I’m ‘prosecutor-like’ is also framing. They say the Innovation Party’s top committee now starts with ‘Yong-morning’—whether they gang up on me 13 to 1 or not, I don’t care; I wish they would just stop paying attention to me.” (“민주당원이었던 적이 단 하루도 없던 사람이 그런 말을 할 자격이 있나. (조 후보야말로) 정부 출범 뒤 광복절 특사로 사면받고 나와 이재명 정부를 도운 게 뭐가 있나. ‘검사스럽다’는 것도 프레임 씌우기다. 요즘 혁신당 최고위는 ‘용모닝’으로 시작한다던데 (조 후보와 혁신당 의원 등) 13 대 1로 붙든지 말든지 관심 없고 내게 그만 관심을 꺼줬으면 좋겠다.”)

―There is also a view that the negative campaigning between the two candidates is intense. (―두 후보의 네거티브전이 격하다는 시선도 있다.)

“If I take out the court ruling related to Candidate Cho Kuk and start scrutinizing him, I can do it better than anyone. But have I ever brought up, for instance, the admissions corruption issues first? I haven’t thrown a single punch.” (“조국 후보 쪽 판결문 가져다 놓고 그를 검증하기 시작하면 어느 누구보다 잘할 수 있다. 그런데 제가 가령 입시 비리 관련해 먼저 언급한 적 있나. 전 한 대도 안 때렸다.”)

―People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong criticizes you for having no ties to the region. (―유의동 국민의힘 후보는 김 후보가 지역 연고가 없다고 비판한다.)

“Saying in Pyeongtaek, now a large metropolitan city in the capital area, that ‘because you weren’t born here, you shouldn’t run here’ is a notion that would have been hard to come by even back in the ‘Pyeongtaek-gun’ days. Two out of five candidates (including Candidate Cho, who sparked controversy with the ‘Pyeongtaek-gun’ remark) are still living in Pyeongtaek-gun.” (“수도권 대도시가 된 평택시에서 ‘여기서 태어나지 않았으니 여기 출마하면 안 된다’는 건 옛날 ‘평택군’ 시절에도 나오기 힘든 발상이다. 후보 5명 중 2명(‘평택군’ 발언으로 논란된 조 후보 포함)은 아직 평택군에 살고 있는 거다.”)

―Is there a possibility of unification with Candidate Cho Kuk or Candidate Kim Jae-yeon? Are there conditions or a timeframe? (―조국 후보나 김재연 후보와 단일화 가능성은. 조건이나 시점이 있나?)

“Didn’t Candidate Cho’s side close the door on unification? They started negative campaigning even before my nomination was confirmed. Unification is only possible when there is a sense of solidarity. As of now, I am not considering it at all.” (“단일화의 문은 조 후보 쪽이 닫아버린 것 아닌가. 제 공천이 확정되기 전부터 네거티브를 시작했다. 단일화도 연대의식이 있을 때 가능하다. 지금으로선 전혀 생각하고 있지 않다.”)

item.title: President Lee to Meet US Treasury Secretary Bessent on Monday; Discuss US-China Summit (이 대통령, 내일 베선트 미 재무장관 접견…미·중 정상회담 등 논의)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung will meet with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on the 13th. (이재명 대통령이 13일 스콧 베선트 미국 재무장관을 접견한다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jeong stated on the 12th, “President Lee will receive a courtesy call from US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on the 13th and will hold a meeting.” President Lee is expected to exchange views with Secretary Bessent on the US-China summit scheduled for the 14th. In particular, issues such as US-China tariff disputes and global supply chain stability measures are expected to be on the agenda. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 12일 “이 대통령은 13일 스콧 베선트 미 재무장관의 예방을 받고 접견할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 베선트 장관과 오는 14일로 예정된 미-중 정상회담에 대한 의견을 교환할 것으로 전망된다. 특히 미·중 관세 문제와 글로벌 공급망 안정 방안 등이 대화 테이블 위에 오를 것으로 관측된다.)

Whether bilateral issues between South Korea and the US will be discussed during this meeting is also a point of interest. Specific details of investment projects in the US, a follow-up measure to the South Korea-US tariff negotiations, or contributions to freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz could also be discussed. Secretary Bessent will visit South Korea on the 13th to attend high-level bilateral economic and trade talks before the US-China summit. (이번 접견에서 한·미 간 현안에 대한 논의가 이뤄질지도 관심사다. 한·미 관세 협상 후속 조처인 대미투자 프로젝트의 구체적인 사업 내용이나 호르무즈해협 자유항행을 위한 기여 방안에 대한 의견도 오갈 수 있다. 베선트 장관은 미-중 정상회담에 앞서 한국에서 열리는 양국 고위급 경제·무역 회담에 참석하기 위해 13일 방한한다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Launches 'Jang Dong-hyuk One-Top Campaign Committee'... Co-Chair U Jae-jun Says "Announced Without Consultation" (국힘 ‘장동혁 원톱 선대위’ 출범…공동선대위원장 우재준은 “상의 없이 발표”)
item.description:
With 22 days to go until the June 3 local elections, the People Power Party has effectively launched a central election committee under a one-top system led by Representative Jang Dong-hyuk. However, Supreme Council member U Jae-jun, a member of the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, who was named as co-campaign committee chair that day, pushed back, saying, "I never agreed to this. I regret that it was announced without consulting me." (6·3 지방선거를 22일 앞두고 국민의힘이 사실상 장동혁 대표 원톱 체제의 중앙선거대책위를 출범시켰다. 그런데 이날 공동선대위원장으로 이름이 올라간 친한동훈계인 우재준 최고위원은 “동의한 적이 없다. 상의 없이 발표한 것에 유감”이라고 반발했다.)

On the 12th, the People Power Party issued a press release announcing the formation of the "National Election Committee to Stop the Cancellation of the People-Disregarding Judgment Prosecution" with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk as the standing co-chairman. Alongside Representative Jang, private experts such as Shim Kyo-eon, a professor in the Department of Real Estate at Konkuk University; Yang Jun-mo, a professor in the Department of Economics at Yonsei University; Lee Yoon-jin, a professor at the Institute for Healthy Aging Society at Konkuk University; and Choi Ji-ye, a director at Jiyesu Co., Ltd., were listed as standing co-chairmen. The People Power Party announced that the co-campaign committee chairs would be floor leader Song Eon-seok, policy committee chairman Jeong Jeom-sik, and Supreme Council members Shin Dong-wook, Kim Min-su, Kim Jae-won, U Jae-jun, and Jo Gwang-han. (국민의힘은 12일 보도자료를 내어 장동혁 대표를 상임선대위원장으로 하는 ‘국민무시 심판 공소취소 저지 국민선거대책위원회’ 구성을 발표했다. 상임선대위원장에는 장 대표와 함께 심교언 건국대 부동산학과 교수, 양준모 연세대 경제학과 교수, 이윤진 건국대 건강고령사회연구원 교수, 최지예 주식회사 지예수 이사 등 민간 전문가들이 이름을 올렸다. 국민의힘은 공동선대위원장은 송언석 원내대표와 정점식 정책위의장, 신동욱·김민수·김재원·우재준·조광한 최고위원이 맡는다고 발표했다.)

However, after the announcement, Supreme Council member U Jae-jun posted on Facebook, stating, "I never agreed to my appointment as co-campaign committee chair," and pushed back, saying, "Given the concerns of candidates in the metropolitan area, there needs to be discussion on the proper way to form the campaign committee." In response, a party leadership official said, "Since the Supreme Council transitions to a campaign committee system during the election phase, Supreme Council members are naturally included." (그러나 우재준 최고위원은 발표 이후 페이스북에 글을 올려 “저는 공동선대위원장 임명에 동의한 적이 없다”며 “수도권 후보자들의 우려가 있는 상황에서 적절한 선대위 구성 방법에 대해서는 논의가 필요하다”고 반발했다. 이에 당 지도부 관계자는 “최고위원회가 선거 국면에서는 선대위 체제로 전환되는 거라 최고위원들은 당연히 포함되는 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Sexual Exploitation Site Operators Arrested...Will Track to the End and Punish Severely" (이 대통령 “성 착취물 사이트 운영진 검거…끝까지 추적해 엄벌”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 12th, "We have additionally arrested the operators who opened and ran an illegal sexual exploitation site in 2022 and had fled abroad," adding, "We will track them to the end and impose severe punishment." (이재명 대통령은 12일 “2022년 불법 성착취물 사이트를 개설·운영하며 해외에 도피해 있던 운영진을 추가로 검거했다”며 “끝까지 추적해 엄벌하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee posted a message on Instagram that afternoon, saying, "We have identified 9 out of 15 operator-level individuals, arrested 8 of them, and also arrested 204 users." (이 대통령은 이날 오후 인스타그램에 글을 올려 “운영자급 15명 중 9명을 특정해 8명을 검거했으며, 이용자 204명도 함께 검거했다”며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, "This is only the beginning," and added, "We will continue to track the top administrators who have not yet been arrested, the remaining forces, and the criminal proceeds." He also issued a warning: "If you thought you could hide overseas and escape the judgment of the law, that is a clear miscalculation." (이 대통령은 “시작에 불과하다”며 “아직 검거되지 않은 최고 관리자와 잔존 세력, 그리고 범죄수익에 대해서도 끝까지 추적할 것”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “해외로 숨어 법의 심판을 피할 수 있다고 생각했다면 이는 명백한 오산”이라는 경고도 남겼다.)

President Lee stated, "Digital sexual violence is a serious crime that tramples on human dignity and a social evil that can never be tolerated." He continued, "I issue a stern warning to everyone involved in the production, distribution, and consumption of illegal sexual exploitation material at this very moment. Do not think you can hide behind anonymity. Digital traces always remain. It is only a matter of time; there is no way to evade responsibility." (이 대통령은 “디지털 성폭력은 인간의 존엄의 짓밟는 중대한 범죄이며, 결코 용납할 수 없는 사회악”이라고 했다. 이어 이 대통령은 “지금 이 순간에도 불법 성착취물 제작, 유통, 소비에 가담하고 있는 모든 이들에게 엄중히 경고한다”며 “익명성 뒤에 숨을 수 있다고 생각하지 마십시오. 디지털 흔적은 반드시 남는다. 시간의 문제일 뿐 책임을 피할 수 있는 방법은 없다”고 했다.)

President Lee wrote, "Watching illegal content is also a clear crime." He added, "As long as demand exists, crime repeats itself. Even simple users will inevitably pay the price, without exception." (이 대통령은 “불법 콘텐츠를 시청하는 것 역시 명백한 범죄”라고 썼다. 이 대통령은 “수요가 존재하는 한 범죄는 반복된다”며 “단순 이용자라 하더라도 예외 없이 반드시 대가를 치르게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

By Choi Ha-yan, Reporter chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Confirms Yun Yong-geun as Candidate for By-election in Gongju, Buyeo, Cheongyang (국힘, 공주·부여·청양 보궐 후보에 윤용근 확정)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) announced on the 12th that Yun Yong-geun, the representative lawyer at law firm L Plus, has been decided as the candidate for the National Assembly by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, South Chungcheong Province. (국민의힘은 12일 충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거 후보로 윤용근 법무법인 엘플러스 대표변호사가 결정됐다고 밝혔다.)

The PPP’s Central Party Nomination Management Committee stated on the same day that after conducting a two-day primary election starting the 11th among three candidates who applied for nomination in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, Representative Lawyer Yun was chosen. Candidate Yun competed against So Jeong-im, the Deputy Head of the party's Finance Committee, and Yun Min-a, a former administrative officer at the Office of the Prime Minister. The primary was conducted using a method of 50% party member delegate voting and 50% general public opinion polling. (국민의힘 중앙당 공천관리위원회는 이날 공주·부여·청양에 공천을 신청한 후보 3명을 대상으로 지난 11일부터 이틀간 경선한 결과 윤 대표변호사가 후보로 결정됐다고 밝혔다. 윤 후보는 소정임 당 재정위원회 부위원장, 윤민아 전 국무총리실 사무관과 경쟁했다. 경선은 당원 선거인단 투표(50%), 일반 국민 여론조사(50%) 방식으로 실시됐다.)

Representative Lawyer Yun is from Buyeo and graduated from Jangam Elementary School, Jangam Middle School, and Buyeo High School. He studied law at Chungnam National University, passed the bar exam, and has worked as a lawyer. He currently serves as the party’s media spokesperson. (윤 대표변호사는 부여 출신으로 장암초·장암중·부여고를 졸업했다. 충남대 사법학과에 진학해 사법시험 합격 뒤 변호사로 활동했다. 현재는 당 미디어대변인을 맡고 있다.)

item.title: "Austerity Ignores People's Hardships"… President Lee Strengthens Expansionary Fiscal Policy Stance (“긴축은 민생고 방관”…이 대통령 적극재정 기조 강화)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 12th, "The government must focus its efforts on laying the groundwork for a major economic leap for the people through proactive fiscal policies." President Lee instructed that the expansionary fiscal policy be reflected in the formulation of the second-half economic growth strategy, to be announced in June, and in the preparation of next year's budget plan. (이재명 대통령이 12일 “정부는 적극적인 재정 정책을 통해 국민 경제 대도약의 발판을 닦는 데 역량을 집중해야 한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 오는 6월 발표할 하반기 경제성장 전략 수립과 내년도 예산안 편성에 적극 재정 정책을 반영하라고 지시했다.)

At a Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office, President Lee said, "Research results have confirmed that active and strategic fiscal management can provide substantial momentum to the people's economy." He added, "The livelihood recovery coupons distributed last year had the effect of boosting local small business sales by an additional 43,000 won per 100,000 won, achieving a total economic effect of 143,000 won for every 100,000 won of fiscal input." Earlier, on the 7th, the Korea Institute of Public Finance had released research findings containing this content. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “재정의 적극적이고 전략적인 운영이 민생경제에 실질적 동력을 제공할 수 있다는 점이 연구 결과로 확인됐다”며 “지난해 지급된 민생회복 쿠폰이 지역 소상공인 매출을 100만원당 추가로 43만원가량 늘리는 효과를 거뒀다. 100만원의 재정 투입을 통해 총 143만원의 경제적 효과를 거둔 것”이라고 말했다. 앞서 지난 7일 한국조세재정연구원은 이런 내용을 담은 연구 결과를 발표했다.)

President Lee remarked, "Despite these objective facts, there are voices in some parts of society demanding austerity as if it’s a constant refrain. They cite national debt as a pretext, but in reality, it’s an irresponsible call to simply stand by and ignore the people’s hardships." This was a rebuttal to criticism from the People Power Party and others, who have denounced the Lee Jae-myung administration's expansionary fiscal policy as a "money-printing populism budget that wrecks fiscal soundness." (이 대통령은 “이런 객관적 사실에도 마치 돌림노래처럼 긴축을 강요하는 목소리가 사회 일각에 존재한다. 국가 채무를 명분으로 들고는 있는데 사실상 민생 고통을 수수방관하라는 무책임한 목소리”라고 말했다. 국민의힘 등이 이재명 정부의 확장재정 정책을 “재정 건전성을 파탄내는 ‘돈풀리즘’ 예산”이라고 비판한 것을 일축한 것이다.)

President Lee said, "There was a time when frugality was a virtue, but now we live in a society where the problem is that money isn't circulating. In times of crisis, saving is also important, but we need to invest more in strengthening the nation's capacity. By revitalizing domestic demand through proactive fiscal measures and raising the economic growth rate and GDP, we can enhance potential growth and productivity in the process, creating a virtuous cycle that thickens the economic growth base." (이 대통령은 “한때 절약이 미덕일 때가 있었지만, 지금은 돈이 안 돌아서 문제인 사회가 됐다”며 “위기 시대에는 아끼는 것도 중요한데 오히려 국가의 역량을 키우는 데 투자할 필요가 있다. 적극적인 재정을 통해 내수를 활성화하고 경제성장률과 국내총생산(GDP)을 높이면 이 과정에서 잠재 성장률과 생산성이 제고돼 경제 성장판이 두터워지는 선순환 구조를 실현할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

President Lee stressed, "We must not fall into the trap of populist austerity fiscal theory that deceives the eyes of the people," adding, "I urge you to proceed with the formulation of the second-half economic growth strategy and next year's budget based on this (expansionary fiscal) stance." (이 대통령은 “국민의 눈을 속이는 포퓰리즘적인 긴축재정론의 함정에 빠져서는 안 된다”며 “이런 (적극 재정) 기조를 바탕으로 하반기 경제 성장 전략 수립과 내년도 예산 편성에 임해주길 당부드린다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the private bad bank 'Sangnoksu,' established during the 2003 credit card crisis, which has not participated in the government's debt relief policy for ordinary people and continues persistent debt collection, President Lee said, "It’s been 20 to 30 years since the credit card crisis—how are people supposed to live if they keep collecting like this now?" He added, "If necessary, we must find a solution, even through legislation." Shareholders of Sangnoksu have shown a passive attitude toward the request to sell long-overdue bonds to the government's bad bank, the 'New Start Fund,' resulting in no support for the rehabilitation of about 90,000 people with bonds totaling 700 billion won as of the end of last year. It is reported that the shareholders have also received about 42 billion won in dividends over the past five years. (한편 이 대통령은 2003년 카드 대란 당시 설립된 민간 배드뱅크 ‘상록수’가 정부의 서민 빚 탕감 정책에 참여하지 않고, 집요한 추심을 하는 것에 관해 “카드 사태가 20~30년이 지났는데, 지금까지 (추심하면) 사람은 어떻게 살라는 거냐”며 “필요하면 입법해서라도 해결 방법을 찾아야 한다”고 말했다. 상록수 출자사들은 장기 연체 채권을 정부 배드뱅크 ‘새출발기금’으로 매각하라는 요청에 소극적 태도를 보이며 지난해 말 기준 약 9만명, 7000억원 규모 채권의 회생 지원이 이뤄지지 않았다. 출자사들은 최근 5년간 420억원가량의 배당도 받은 것으로 전해졌다.)

By Seo Young-ji and Shim Woo-sam yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 심우삼 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Hyung-joon "Did you receive a Cartier watch?"…Jeon Jae-soo "Why didn't you sell LCT?" (박형준 “까르띠에 시계 받았나”…전재수 “엘시티 왜 안 팔았나”)
item.description:
On the 12th, Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party candidate, and Park Hyung-joon, the People Power Party candidate, clashed in a TV debate for the June 3 local elections for Busan mayor. Candidate Jeon emphasized "completing Busan as a maritime capital," while Candidate Park stressed "continued development without interruption." (6·3 지방선거 부산시장 선거에 출마한 전재수 더불어민주당 후보와 박형준 국민의힘 후보가 12일 티브이(TV) 토론에서 맞붙었다. 전 후보는 “해양수도 부산 완성”을, 박 후보는 “중단 없는 발전 지속”을 내세웠다.)

In his opening remarks at the debate held at Busan MBC in Dong-gu, Busan, Candidate Jeon stated, "I will achieve the 'completion of the maritime capital' through the relocation of public institutions to Busan, attracting a maritime specialized court, and moving the headquarters of major shipping companies to Busan." Candidate Park highlighted his administrative achievements, saying, "Over the past five years (during his term as Busan mayor), the amount of investment attracted (to Busan) increased 28-fold compared to 2020." (전 후보는 이날 부산 동구 부산문화방송(MBC)에서 열린 토론회 머리발언에서 “공공기관 부산 이전과 해사전문법원 유치, 해운 대기업 본사 부산 이전 등을 통해 ‘해양수도 완성’을 이뤄내겠다”고 말했다. 박 후보는 “지난 5년 (부산시장 임기 동안 부산으로) 투자유치액이 2020년에 견줘 28배 증가하는 등의 성과가 있었다”고 시정 성과를 강조했다.)

Candidate Park pressed Candidate Jeon, asking, "Did you receive the Cartier watch (that you were allegedly given by the Unification Church) or not?" In response, Candidate Jeon mentioned that last month, the joint investigation team of prosecutors and police concluded the case with a 'no right to prosecute' decision, and rebutted, "You are engaging in negative campaigning with a concluded investigation result. Votes won't come from framing me as if I had suspicions but the prosecutors and police closed the case anyway." (박 후보는 전 후보를 향해 “(전 후보가 통일교로부터 받았다는 의혹이 불거진) 까르띠에 시계를 받았느냐 안 받았느냐”며 몰아붙였다. 이에 전 후보는 지난달 이 사건을 수사한 검경 합동수사본부가 ‘공소권 없음’ 결론을 내린 것을 언급하며 “종결된 수사 결과를 가지고 네거티브를 하고 있다”며 “제게 혐의가 있는데도 검경이 사건을 종결한 것처럼 프레임을 씌워선 표가 나오지 않는다”고 반박했다.)

Candidate Jeon brought up the controversy over preferential sales of LCT (Lotte Chemical Tower) involving Candidate Park during the 2021 Busan mayoral by-election, attacking him by saying, "Didn't Candidate Park promise to sell LCT? Isn't failing to keep that promise a lie?" Candidate Park responded, "I'm unable to sell it because I've become a kind of lease damage victim. I'm sorry for not keeping my word." (전 후보는 2021년 부산시장 보궐선거 당시 불거졌던 박 후보의 엘시티(LCT) 특혜 분양 의혹을 언급하며 “박 후보는 엘시티를 판다고 약속하지 않았느냐. 지키지 않는 것은 거짓말이 아니냐”고 공격했다. 박 후보는 “일종의 전세 피해자가 돼서 못 팔고 있다. 공언한 것을 지키지 못해서 죄송하다”고 했다.)

Reporters Choi Ha-yan and Kim Chae-woon chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 김채운 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: “Jung Won-oh, Worried About Halting Redevelopment” “Seoul’s North-South Gap Widened Under Oh Se-hoon” (“정원오, 재개발 멈출까 걱정” “오세훈 시절 강남·북 격차 커져”)
item.description:
The key to the June 3 local elections for Seoul mayor lies in real estate and development. Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party are locked in near-daily debates over real estate policies. Each candidate is pushing their own property and development agenda, with Jung expanding his reach into Gangnam and Oh into Gangbuk. On the 12th, The Hankyoreh visited the four Gangnam districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa, and Gangdong-gu), where Jung is weaker, and the Gangbuk areas of Nowon, Dobong, Gangbuk-gu, and Eunpyeong-gu, where Oh is weaker, to hear from residents. (6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거전을 압축하는 열쇳말은 부동산과 개발이다. 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 거의 매일 부동산 정책을 두고 설전을 벌이고 있다. 두 후보는 각자의 부동산, 개발 정책을 들고 정 후보는 강남으로, 오 후보는 강북으로 외연 확장에 열심이다. 한겨레는 12일 정 후보의 약세지인 강남 4구(강남·서초·송파·강동구)와 오 후보의 약세지인 강북 노·도·강(노원·도봉·강북구)과 은평구를 찾아 시민들의 말을 들었다.)

"Worried Jung Won-oh as Mayor Would Halt Redevelopment and Reconstruction" <<> "It seems like he's making redevelopment promises just to gain popularity in Gangnam, but I dislike the populism of the Lee Jae-myung administration so much, and it looks like everything will turn blue (Democratic Party), so I’m considering casting a protest vote." (A 57-year-old man named Kwon) <<> "Meeting Jung Won-oh in person eased my concerns quite a bit about reconstruction being blocked." (Ma Jong-hyuk, head of the Gaepo Usung 7th Apartment Reconstruction Union) <<> Gangnam residents have mixed views on Jung Won-oh, who is courting conservative votes in the area. Jung has demanded the party form a special committee for the four Gangnam districts and has been visiting them daily, pledging to resolve local issues like redevelopment and reconstruction. That day, he unveiled a pledge to supply over 360,000 housing units by 2031. Given Seoul’s demographic structure, winning the Gangnam vote is crucial for victory. The population of the Gangnam area, which accounts for over 20% of Seoul’s total, has recently seen a slight increase. A member of Jung’s campaign explained, "We need to win in the Han River belt (Yongsan, Seongdong, Mapo, Yeongdeungpo, Dongjak, Gwangjin, Gangdong-gu, etc.) and perform well in Gangnam to secure election victory." <<> Lee (65), met outside the Apgujeong Hyundai Apartment reconstruction union office in Gangnam-gu on the 12th, said, "Under Mayor Park Won-soon, all redevelopment and reconstruction stopped. It was a lost decade." He added, "That trauma means I won’t vote for the Democratic Party." Ju (50), a resident of the Gaepo Usung 7th Apartment in Irwon-dong, remarked, "I don’t particularly like Oh Se-hoon, but the progressives (Democratic Party) take too much in taxes, so I plan to vote for the red party (People Power Party)." <<> In contrast, residents of Geoyeo-dong in Songpa-gu, where public redevelopment is being pursued, expressed hope. A woman in her 60s who runs a clothing store said, "Since I’m a commoner, I’m more likely to vote for Jung Won-oh over Oh Se-hoon, who only looks out for the rich." <<> Gangnam residents without a direct stake in redevelopment or reconstruction also voiced dissatisfaction with Jung’s real estate policies. Kim Yoo-jung (35), a resident of Gaepo-dong, said, "For those like me who rent, when nearby apartments are reconstructed, it only raises housing prices, making it harder to enter Gangnam." <<> <<> "Did the Gangnam-Gangbuk Gap Narrow Under Oh Se-hoon’s Term?" <<> "From a Gangbuk resident’s perspective, there’s definitely expectation for policies on transportation, housing, and living infrastructure pledges." (A 33-year-old office worker named Kim) <<> "Gangnam apartments cost billions of won, but our apartment, at 33 pyeong, is worth less than 1 billion won. I don’t know what Mayor Oh has done for Gangbuk so far. Residents of Nowon, Dobong, and Gangbuk don’t feel much impact." (A merchant at Ssangmun Market) <<> Gangbuk residents, while paying attention to Oh Se-hoon’s development pledges for the region, have not hidden their doubts about their feasibility. Oh recently unveiled the "Rapid Integrated Planning 2.0" pledge for redevelopment in Gangbuk and has been visiting Gangbuk-gu, Dobong-gu, and Eunpyeong-gu to court voters. <<> Lee Jang-gyu (40s), a real estate agent in Mia-dong, Gangbuk-gu, where the rapid integrated plan was finalized in March, explained, "Many people in this area have lived here for decades. They oppose redevelopment because money doesn’t just flow into their bank accounts." Jung (32), who owns a home in one of the candidate sites for the rapid integrated plan in Eunpyeong-gu, said, "Many candidate sites have been designated recently, and since the Lee Jae-myung government has also signaled a housing supply push, I’m hopeful." <<> Lee Eung-jun (35), an office worker living in Eungam-dong, Eunpyeong-gu, said, "If he presents concrete measures to accelerate the western line development, it could sway local voters. I’m half-convinced because I’ve never seen things resolved through elections or pledges, but I’m watching Oh’s western line pledge closely." On the 10th, Oh announced the phased early completion of seven urban railway lines, including the western line, by 2037. <<> Fatigue over Oh, who has served four terms as mayor, was also evident. Song (54), from Wolgye-dong, Nowon-gu, said, "I think it’s good for parties to alternate. This time, it might be better to have a Democratic Party mayor." <<> A member of Oh’s campaign stated, "We’ll explain key Gangbuk policies, such as using part of the profits from the Gangnam Express Bus Terminal development as public contributions to fund the undergrounding of the inner ring road. We’ll also allocate significant time to Gangbuk going forward." In the 21st presidential election last year, then-Democratic candidate Lee Jae-myung received 392,998 votes in Nowon, Dobong, and Gangbuk-gu, while People Power candidate Kim Moon-soo got only 288,001. In Gangnam, Seocho, and Songpa-gu, Lee garnered 406,122 votes, while Kim received 575,807. <<> Jung Hye-min and Yoo Young-jae, reporters jhm@hani.co.kr ( “정원오 시장 되면 재개발·재건축 멈출까 걱정”)

item.title: "'Garden of Gratitude' Bursting with Pride" Oh Se-hoon... "Strategic Role Division with Jang Dong-hyuk" (“‘감사의 정원’ 자부심 뿜뿜” 오세훈…“장동혁과 전략적 역할 분담”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, said on the 13th, "A strategic role division with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk is necessary." (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보는 13일 “장동혁 대표와 전략적 역할 분담이 필요하다”고 말했다.)

When asked on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show," "You've been urging Representative Jang for change. Do you consider this the change you wanted?" Candidate Oh replied, "I am conducting a new type of campaign through the Citizens' Election Committee, promoting Seoul's policies. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk continuing to criticize the 'Special Counsel for Repeal of Prosecution' or effectively condemning the government's absurd policies, such as the major blunder by former Blue House Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom yesterday—that's what the party leadership should do." (오 후보는 이날 SBS(에스비에스) 라디오 ‘김태현의 정치쇼’ 에서 “장 대표에게 변화를 계속 촉구했는데, 원하는 변화가 됐다고 보느냐”는 질문에 “저는 시민선대위를 통해 서울시의 정책을 알리는 등의 새로운 형태의 선거운동을 하고 있다. 장동혁 대표는 계속해서 ‘공소취소 특검’을 비판한다든가, 어제 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 대형사고를 친 것 등 정부의 터무니없는 정책을 효과적으로 비판하는 게 당 지도부가 할 일”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding the gap in approval ratings with Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate, Oh said "it's narrowing rapidly" and "if this trend continues, I can do it. However, the playing field is still heavily slanted, so I have to make desperate efforts." He added, "When it comes to self-praise, the fact that Seoul citizens have elected me four times is because I do my job well. I'm the original 'hard worker' and a 'policy front-runner.'" (오 후보는 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 지지율 격차가 “빠른 속도로 줄고 있다”며 “이 추세대로만 가면 할 수 있다. 다만 아직 운동장 자체가 많이 기울어져 있는 판이기 때문에 처절한 노력을 해야 한다”고 말했다. 그는 “선거니까 자화자찬 한다면 서울시민들이 저를 일 잘하니까 네 번이나 뽑아주신 것이고, 제가 원조 ‘일잘러’이고 정책 ‘앞질러’”라고 했다.)

Regarding the controversy over the 'Garden of Gratitude' at Gwanghwamun Square, which was completed the previous day, Oh said, "It is a space filled with the message of gratitude for the tens of thousands of foreign youths who sacrificed themselves during the war, allowing South Korea to survive, and that thanks to them, South Korea has transformed into a country that provides aid. If students or citizens go and see it, they will feel bursting with pride." (오 후보는 전날 준공한 서울 광화문광장 ‘감사의 정원’ 논란과 관련해 “전쟁 때 수만명의 외국 젊은이들이 와서 희생해 대한민국이 생존한 데 대한 감사와 그 덕분에 대한민국이 원조를 주는 나라로 바뀌었다는 메시지가 가득한 공간”이라며 “학생들이나 국민들이 가서 보면 자부심 뿜뿜”이라고 말했다.)

The 23 structures, each 6.25 meters tall, symbolizing the 23 countries that participated in the Korean War, installed near the statue of King Sejong in Gwanghwamun Square, have sparked controversy as they resemble the shape of a "present arms" rifle salute. (광화문광장 세종대왕상 근처에 설치된 한국전쟁 참전 23개국을 상징하는 6.25m 높이 조형물 23개는 ‘받들어총’ 모양을 연상시켜 논란이 되고 있다.)

item.title: Cho Hyun: “Several possible actors behind the flying object strike on the ‘M/T HMM’…including Iranian militias” (조현 “‘나무호 타격’ 비행체 발사 주체 여럿 가능…이란 민병대 포함”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said on the 13th that it is currently impossible to conclude that the Iranian government was the actor that launched the “flying object” at a South Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, and that it could have been a militia group. <<> Minister Cho, meeting with reporters at the government complex in Seoul, responded to a question about whether the flying object that struck the M/T HMM likely came from a drone by stating: “It is difficult to specify prematurely. Particularly, regarding the actor that launched it, there could be many possibilities beyond just Iran. There could also be militias.” When asked if he was considering the possibility that the attacker was a militia, he said, “It’s not that I am considering it, but that there is a possibility.” <<> Some have raised the possibility that the flying object that struck the M/T HMM was a Shahed suicide drone, which Iran has frequently used in its conflicts with the United States. Such suicide drones, including the Shahed, are operated not only by Iran’s regular military and Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps but also by the Houthi rebels and militias backed by Iran. Minister Cho’s comments today are interpreted as meaning that even if the flying object is identified as an Iranian drone, it cannot be concluded which Iranian actor launched it. <<> The government plans to bring drone engine debris collected from the M/T HMM to South Korea for detailed analysis to identify the model of the flying object, then analyze the overall circumstances to make a final judgment on the attacker. When asked when the debris would arrive in South Korea, Minister Cho simply replied, “It needs to come quickly.” <<> Experts say that even if the engine debris recovered from the M/T HMM is identified as belonging to an Iranian drone, information such as the flight trajectory is crucial to clarify who launched it. Considering the circumstances at the time, when significant U.S. reconnaissance assets were concentrated in the Strait of Hormuz as part of Operation Liberation Project, intelligence cooperation with the U.S. is deemed important. <<> A senior government official, during a meeting with South Korean correspondents at the South Korean Embassy in Washington on the 12th (local time), stated regarding the M/T HMM incident that “it is true that we have had extensive discussions” with the U.S. side, but regarding specific details, he said, “there are many elements that limit what I can share.” When asked whether the South Korean government’s assessment was slower than that of the U.S., he replied, “We cannot make a definitive conclusion before it is confirmed,” adding, “We need to wait for the government’s joint investigative team’s conclusions.” <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr Washington / Special Correspondent Kim Won-chul wonchul@hani.co.kr (조현 외교부 장관은 13일 호르무즈해협에서 한국 선박에 ‘비행체’를 발사할만한 주체가 이란 정부라고 현재로서는 단정할 수 없고 민병대 등일 가능성도 있다고 말했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] 4-term lawmaker Park Deok-heum elected as People Power Party’s candidate for Vice Speaker of the National Assembly ([속보] 4선 박덕흠, 국힘 몫 국회부의장 후보 선출)
item.description:
Park Deok-heum, a four-term lawmaker representing Boeun, Okcheon, Yeongdong, and Goesan in North Chungcheong Province, has been elected as the candidate for Vice Speaker of the National Assembly from the People Power Party. (국민의힘 몫 국회부의장 후보로 4선의 박덕흠 의원(충북 보은·옥천·영동·괴산)이 선출됐다.)

The People Power Party held a general meeting of its lawmakers at the National Assembly on the morning of the 13th and selected Park as the candidate for Vice Speaker. Park competed in a three-way race with lawmakers Cho Kyoung-tae (six-term, Saha-eul, Busan) and Cho Bae-sook (five-term, proportional representative). Subsequently, the National Assembly will hold a plenary session to finalize Park’s election as Vice Speaker. (국민의힘은 13일 오전 국회에서 당 의원총회를 열어 박 의원을 국회부의장 후보로 뽑았다. 박 의원은 조경태(6선·부산 사하을), 조배숙(5선·비례대표) 의원과 3파전을 벌였다. 이후 국회는 본회의를 열어 박 의원을 국회 부의장으로 최종 선출하게 된다.)

After challenging for the Vice Speaker position in the first half of the 22nd National Assembly, Park has now thrown his hat in the ring for the second time. Park, who currently serves as the chair of the People Power Party’s nomination management committee, was urgently deployed after the “first nomination management committee” for the June 3 local elections was disbanded midway, completing the nomination process. (박 의원은 22대 국회 전반기에 국회부의장에 도전한 데 이어 이번에 두 번째로 부의장 자리에 출사표를 던졌다. 현재 국민의힘 공천관리위원장인 박 의원은 6·3 지방선거 ‘1기 공천관리위원회’가 중도 해체된 뒤 긴급 투입돼 공천 작업을 마무리했다.)

A native of Okcheon, North Chungcheong Province, Park has served four consecutive terms representing Boeun, Okcheon, Yeongdong, and Goesan. In September 2020, while serving as a member of the National Assembly’s Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee for five years, a conflict of interest issue arose when it was revealed that his family’s company had won construction projects worth hundreds of billions of won from agencies under his committee’s oversight. He left the party over the controversy but rejoined in January 2022. (충북 옥천 출신으로 보은·옥천·영동·괴산에서 내리 4선을 지낸 박 의원은 2020년 9월, 국회 국토교통위원회 위원으로 있던 5년간 가족 회사가 피감기관으로부터 수천억원대 공사를 수주했다는 이해충돌 문제가 불거져 탈당했다가 2022년 1월 복당한 바 있다.)

Reported by Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr and Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)
