item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "People Power Party, an 'Insurrection Advocate,' Subject to Unconstitutional Party Dissolution... Must Face Voter Judgment in Local Elections" (정청래 “‘내란 옹호’ 국민의힘, 위헌정당 해산 대상…지선서 민심 심판 받아야”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 13th, "The People Power Party is an anti-constitutional, anti-democratic force that advocates insurrection and can be subject to a review for the dissolution of an unconstitutional party," adding, "Before any such dissolution review, they must face the severe judgment of the people in the upcoming June 3 local elections." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 13일 “국민의힘은 내란을 옹호하는 반헌법, 반민주 세력이며 위헌 정당 해산 심판의 대상이 될 수 있다”며 “위헌 정당 해산 심판 이전에 이번 6·3 지방선거에서 민심의 혹독한 심판을 받아야 한다”고 말했다.)

Leader Jung made these remarks during a press conference at the party leader's office in the National Assembly on this day, eight days before the start of the election campaign, where he reported on the progress of candidate nominations and policy achievements. "Through the June 3 local elections, we must decisively judge the forces of insurrection and eliminate even the traces of it," Jung emphasized. "By doing so, we must fully normalize the country and establish competent local governments to firmly support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (정 대표는 선거운동 시작일을 8일 앞둔 이날 국회 당대표 회의실에서 공천 경과와 정책 성과 등을 보고하는 기자회견을 열고 이렇게 말했다. 정 대표는 “6·3 지방선거를 통해 내란 세력을 확실하게 심판하고, 내란의 티끌까지도 청산해내야 한다”며 “이를 통해 국가를 완전히 정상화하고 일 잘하는 지방정부를 세워 이재명 정부의 성공을 든든하게 뒷받침해야 한다”라고 강조했다.)

Furthermore, Jung proudly described the nominations for this local election as "the unprecedented nominations of four 'no's and four strong points." He stated, "There were no unjust cuts, no nominations of unqualified candidates, no parachute appointments, and no corruption." He also added, "The party's policies and pledges are being consolidated into policies created together with party members and pledges made alongside the people," and reintroduced the major pledges the party had previously announced. (아울러 정 대표는 이번 지방선거 공천은 ‘역대급 4무 4강 공천’이라고 자부했다. 정 대표는 “억울한 컷오프가 없고, 부적격자 공천이 없고, 낙하산 공천 없고, 부정부패도 없었다”라고 했다. 또 “당의 정책과 공약 또한 당원들과 함께 만드는 정책, 국민과 함께 만드는 공약으로 집대성하고 있다”면서 그간 당이 발표했던 주요 공약들을 다시 소개했다.)

Regarding the election campaign, he pledged, "We will not use eye-sore, pollution-level banners that tear down other parties, but will instead conduct a policy- and performance-focused promotional campaign that resonates with the people, allowing them to feel a sense of reward and joy." He promised, "We will show an election campaign where we are 'one team, united as one.'" (선거 운동에 대해서도 “다른 당을 깎아내리며 눈살을 찌푸리게 하는 공해 수준의 도배 현수막이 아니라 국민이 공감할 수 있고, 국민이 보람과 기쁨을 느낄 수 있는 정책 중심, 성과 중심의 홍보전을 펼치겠다”라며 “‘혼연일체로 원팀이 되는 선거운동’을 보여드리겠다”라고 약속했다.)

By Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr and Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Defense Minister An Kyu-baek Meets US Navy Chief in Washington, Asks for Support for Nuclear Submarines as "Milestone in Alliance Upgrade" (방미 안규백 장관, 미 해군 수장 만나 “핵잠, 동맹격상 이정표” 지지 당부)
item.description:
South Korean Defense Minister An Kyu-baek, currently visiting the United States, has met with the acting US Secretary of the Navy to request support for South Korea's introduction of nuclear-powered submarines (nuclear subs). (미국을 방문 중인 안규백 국방부 장관이 미 해군성 장관 대행을 만나 한국의 핵추진잠수함(핵잠) 도입에 대한 지지를 요청했다.)

According to the Ministry of National Defense on the 13th, Minister An met with Acting US Navy Secretary Hung Cao in Washington on the morning of the 12th (local time) to discuss key alliance issues. Minister An emphasized that South Korea's introduction of nuclear subs would contribute to enhancing mutual security interests between South Korea and the US and serve as an important milestone in upgrading the South Korea-US alliance, urging active support from the Navy Department. He also stressed that South Korea not only possesses excellent shipbuilding productivity but has also established a legal basis for investment in the US through the enactment of a special law on investment in the US, making it the optimal partner for cooperation in the shipbuilding sector. <<> The two ministers agreed to continue close cooperation between the two countries going forward, the Ministry of National Defense reported. The US Department of Defense includes the Departments of the Army, Navy, and Air Force under its umbrella, with the Navy Department overseeing the Navy and Marine Corps. <<> The South Korea-US leaders agreed in a joint fact sheet from their two summits last year to cooperate on South Korea's construction of nuclear subs. However, subsequent negotiations have stalled due to US dissatisfaction with delays in South Korea's implementation of investments in the US and issues related to Coupang (or military base pollution issues as previously raised in some contexts, but here likely referring to general impasses) acting as a stumbling block. <<> During his visit to the US, Minister An also met with key congressional figures including US Senate Armed Services Committee Chairman Roger Wicker, committee ranking member Jack Reed, and Senator Rick Scott, chair of the Seapower Subcommittee, to discuss alliance issues such as the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON). He explained South Korea's will and efforts to take a leading role in defending the Korean Peninsula and emphasized the importance of maintaining a combined defense posture on the peninsula, before requesting support from the US Congress for OPCON transition and nuclear sub construction. On the 11th, he met with US Defense Secretary (referring to the Secretary of Defense, though the text mentions "전쟁부 장관" which could be an older term) Pete Hegseth to discuss pending issues including OPCON transition and South Korea's contributions to resuming navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. <<> In a meeting with correspondents at the South Korean Embassy in Washington on the same day, Minister An said regarding the push for nuclear sub construction, "I believe security issues should be approached on a different track from economic issues," and added, "While it's not an issue that can be resolved overnight given that the US is at war with Iran and trade issues are also entangled, we agreed that practical consultations should be convened as soon as possible, taking into account issues with China and North Korea." <<> A senior government official said this visit and talks were arranged at South Korea's proposal. He described it as "a procedural process of seeking understanding and persuasion through mutual communication, given the accumulation of various pending issues between South Korea and the US." <<> Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr <<> Kim Won-chul, Correspondent in Washington wonchul@hani.co.kr (13일 국방부에 따르면 안 장관은 12일(현지시각) 오전 워싱턴에서 헝 카오 미 해군성 장관대행을 접견하고 주요 동맹 현안을 논의했다. 안 장관은 한국의 핵잠 도입이 한·미 공동 안보이익 증진에 기여하고 한-미 동맹 격상의 중요한 이정표가 될 것이라고 강조하며 해군성 차원의 적극적인 지지를 당부했다. 한국이 함정 건조에 우수한 생산성을 보유하고 있을 뿐 아니라, 대미투자특별법 제정을 통해 대미투자의 법적 근거를 마련한 만큼 조선 협력에서 미국의 최적 협력 파트너라고도 강조했다.)

item.title: North Korea's Kim Jong-un "Strengthen Mortar and Howitzer Forces"… Inspects Munitions Factories in Successive Moves (북한 김정은 “박격포·곡사포 무력 강화”…연일 군수공장 시찰)
item.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong-un inspected munitions factories producing shells and ordered the "strengthening of mortar and howitzer forces." (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 포탄 생산 군수공장을 시찰하고 ‘박격포와 곡사포 무력 강화'를 주문했다.)

The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 12th that Kim visited several munitions industrial sites the previous day for on-site guidance and "looked into the implementation status of munitions production tasks for the first half of 2026." (조선중앙통신은 12일 김 위원장이 전날 여러 군수공업기업소를 방문해 현지 지도하고 “2026년 상반년도 군수생산 과제 수행실태를 료해(파악)”했다고 보도했다.)

At a bullet manufacturing plant, Kim presented important tasks for establishing a production system to meet the demand for high-precision multi-purpose rounds of various calibers, special-function rounds, and training rounds. KCNA reported that Kim particularly emphasized the "strengthening of mortar and howitzer forces" and outlined key tasks for enhancing the modernity and specialization of artillery shell production plants, including "establishing a specialized artillery weapon production complex and a sniper weapon production plant to meet the prospective needs of our armed forces." Specific details of the tasks were not disclosed. (김 위원장은 총탄 생산공장에서 구경별 고정밀 다목적탄과 특수기능탄, 훈련탄의 수요와 그에 따르는 생산체계 확립을 위한 중요 과업을 제시했다. 그는 특히 “박격포와 곡사포 무력 강화”를 강조하면서 “우리 무력의 전망적 수요를 충족시키기 위하여 전문화된 포 무기 생산종합체와 저격 무기 생산공장 설립” 등 총포탄 생산공장의 현대성·전문성을 제고하기 위한 주요 과업을 밝혔다고 조선중앙통신은 전했다. 과업의 구체적인 내용은 공개하지 않았다.)

Kim stated, "Our munitions industry's structure, production systems, and facilities still harbor shortcomings," and added, "We must focus on practical renewal of production structures and rational arrangement of production processes for modernization, realize optimization in technical management, talent management, and labor management, and vigorously wage a struggle to continuously enhance production efficiency." (김 위원장은 “우리 군수공업의 구조와 생산체계, 시설들에 의연(여전히) 결점들이 잠재한다”며 “생산구조의 실용적인 갱신과 생산공정들의 합리적인 배치 등 현대화에 주력하며 기술관리, 인재관리, 로력(인력)관리의 최적화를 실현하고 생산의 효율성을 부단히 높여나가기 위한 투쟁을 힘있게 벌려나가야 한다”고 했다.)

Accompanying him on this inspection were Jo Chun-ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jong-sik, first deputy director of the Party's Munitions Industry Department, military veteran Park Jeong-cheon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defense, Kim Kang-il, vice minister of National Defense and director of the Equipment General Bureau, Yu Chang-seon, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff, Kim Myeong-seon, director of the Weapons Review Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense, and Kim Yong-hwan, director of the National Defense Science Institute, among others. (이번 시찰에는 조춘룡 조선노동당 중앙위원회 비서, 김정식 당 군수공업부 제1부부장, 군부 원로 박정천 국방성 고문, 김강일 국방성 부상 겸 장비총국장, 유창선 총참모부 포병국장, 김명선 국방성 병기심사국장, 김용환 국방과학원장 등이 수행했다.)

Kim visited a "major munitions factory" on the 6th, stating he would deploy new 155mm self-propelled howitzers capable of targeting Seoul to the "southern border." On the 7th, accompanied by his daughter Ju-ae, he boarded the destroyer "Choi Hyun-ho" ahead of its commissioning to observe comprehensive evaluation tests, continuing his recent flurry of military activities. (김 위원장은 지난 6일 ‘중요군수기업소'를 방문해 서울을 사정권에 둘 수 있는 신형 155㎜ 자주포를 ‘남부 국경'에 배치하겠다고 밝혔고, 7일에는 딸 주애와 함께 취역을 앞둔 구축함 ‘최현호'에 탑승해 종합평가시험을 참관하는 등 연일 군사행보를 보이고 있다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok: "Han Dong-hoon didn't see a falling cameraman? That's like 'Biden-Nalimyeon' talk" (이준석 “한동훈, 넘어진 기자 못 봤다? ‘바이든-날리면’ 같은 얘기”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, criticized independent candidate Han Dong-hoon’s explanation that he "did not notice" a cameraman falling off a stage during his press conference for the by-election in Busan's Buk-gu Gap district, calling it "the same kind of story as 'Biden-Nalimyeon.'" (한동훈 부산 북갑 보궐선거 무소속 후보가 출마 기자회견 당시 카메라 기자가 무대에서 넘어지는 것을 “인지하지 못했다”고 해명한 것을 두고 이준석 개혁신당 대표가 “‘바이든-날리면’ 같은 이야기”라고 비판했다.)

In an appearance on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" on the 13th, Lee said, "Whether he saw it or not, it seems unlikely he didn't see it," adding, "To claim he didn't see it is, in my opinion, too much like the 'Biden-Nalimyeon' story." This refers to former President Yoon Suk-yeol's 2022 visit to the US, where he was reported as saying, "If those b*stards in the National Assembly don't approve it, Biden would be so embarrassed." When the media covered this, Yoon gave a far-fetched explanation that he said "Nalimyeon" (a type of noodle dish), not "Biden." Lee was drawing a parallel to Han's explanation. ( 이 대표는 13일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “(한 후보가) 봤냐, 못 봤냐, 못 본 건 아닌 것 같다”며 “그걸 못 봤다고 하기엔 너무나도 제 생각엔 ‘바이든-날리면’ 같은 이야기”라고 말했다. 지난 2022년 윤석열 전 대통령은 미국 방문 당시 “국회에서 이 ××들이 승인 안 해주면 바이든은 쪽팔려서 어떡하냐”고 발언한 내용을 언론에서 보도하자 “‘바이든’이 아니고 ‘날리면’”이라는 억지 해명을 내놓은 바 있다. 이를 한 후보의 해명에 빗댄 것이다. )

Lee further speculated, "But after seeing it, Han probably thought from his angle that the reporter was safe or had gotten up, and then moved on," adding, "Moments like that will gradually affect voters." ( 이 대표는 “그런데 보고 나서 한 후보 입장에서는 우리가 못 보는 시야에서 (기자가) 안전하구나 또는 털고 일어났구나 이 정도로 인지하고 가신 게 아닌가 생각한다”며 “그런 게 유권자에게는 조금씩 영향을 미치는 순간이 올 것”이라고 내다봤다. )

The cameraman's fall incident occurred on the 9th during Han's press conference at a small park near Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan. In a video uploaded to Han's official YouTube channel, a broadcast cameraman, while backing up to film Han stepping onto the stage, fell off it. Han's spokesperson, who collided with the falling cameraman, staggered significantly and also fell. ( 카메라 기자 추락 사고는 지난 9일 부산 북구 구포시장 근처 쌈지공원에서 열린 한 후보 출마 기자회견 현장에서 발생했다. 한 후보 공식 유튜브 채널에 올라온 영상을 보면, 한 방송사의 카메라 기자가 무대 위로 올라오는 한 후보를 찍기 위해 뒷걸음질을 치다 무대 아래로 떨어졌다. 떨어지는 카메라 기자와 부딪힌 한 후보의 대변인이 크게 휘청거리면서 함께 넘어지기도 했다. )

At the moment of the fall, Han was waving his hand while looking in the opposite direction, but immediately turned his head toward where the cameraman had fallen. Han continued to look in that direction for about four seconds, which led to the spread of the related video on YouTube and social media (SNS), drawing criticism that he was aware of the accident but remained indifferent. ( 떨어지는 순간 한 후보는 반대쪽을 바라보며 손을 흔들고 있었지만 직후 카메라 기자가 떨어진 쪽으로 고개를 돌렸다. 이후에도 한 후보는 4초가량 카메라 기자가 떨어진 쪽을 바라봤는데 이 때문에 유튜브와 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에서는 관련 영상이 확산하며 한 후보가 사고가 난 것을 알면서도 무신경했다는 비판이 일었다.)

Han's side countered on the 10th, saying, "Han did not notice the reporter falling, which is clearly verifiable in the video," and "Immediately after the situation occurred, Han checked with the host and was told, 'It's okay,' and then proceeded with the press conference." ( 한 후보 쪽에서는 10일 “한 후보는 해당 기자가 넘어지는 것을 인지하지 못했으며 이는 영상에서 충분히 확인 가능하다”고 반박했다. “상황 발생 직후 한 후보는 사회자에게 상황을 확인했으며, 현장에서 ‘괜찮다’는 답변을 받은 뒤 기자회견을 진행했다”는 것이다. )

However, the controversy does not seem to subside. People Power Party lawmaker Kwon Young-se, appearing on Channel A's "Politics Signal" on the 12th, said, "Looking at the video, you see Han turning around and looking, and people gathering as someone falls. There would have been murmuring and noise," adding, "I don't think he couldn't have known." He continued, "When there's a problem, it's better to honestly admit it and apologize. Trying to patch it up temporarily only makes it harder," criticizing, "He should have said, 'I saw it but I was careless,' or admitted what he could. But saying he didn't see it is a dishonest attitude." (하지만 논란은 사그라지지 않는 모양새다. 권영세 국민의힘 의원은 12일 채널에이(A) ‘정치시그널’에 나와 “영상을 보니까 (한 후보가) 뒤돌아서 쳐다보는 모습이 나오고 사람들이 쓰러지니까 몰리는 모습도 있다. 웅성웅성하고 소리도 났을 거고”라며 “(한 후보가) 몰랐을 리는 없겠다 생각한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “문제가 있을 때 솔직하게 인정하고 사과를 하는 게 좋지, 임시방편으로 막으려고 하면 그게 더 어렵다”며 “봤지만 제가 생각이 짧았다든지 바로 인정할 건 인정했어야지, 그걸 못 봤다. 이렇게 얘기하는 건 정직하지 못한 태도”라고 비판했다.)

In response, Han directly addressed the issue in an interview with KNN on the 12th. Han replied as follows: ( 그러자 한 후보는 12일 케이엔엔(KNN)과 인터뷰에서 직접 해명에 나섰다. 한 후보는 다음과 같이 답했다. )

"I saw our spokesperson lying there like that. Hey, what happened, I asked the spokesperson, and someone had helped him up, what was it? From my perspective, it seemed like that, and when I asked, 'Are you okay?' they said they were fine, so I moved on. I had no awareness of the situation at all, but still, they came to film my event properly, right? It doesn't seem like they were badly injured. But still, it could have been serious, and in that sense, I feel sorry." (“우리 대변인이 이렇게 넘어져 있더라고요. 어 왜 그러냐, 대변인한테 물어봤는데 한 분이 일으켰고 뭐지? 저는 이런 정도 상황이었는데 괜찮냐? 하니까 괜찮다고 해서 제가 넘어갔는데. 저는 그 당시 상황을 인지는 전혀 못 했습니다만 그래도 제 행사를 잘 찍어주시려고 오신 거잖아요. 많이 다치시거나 그런 거 같진 않아요. 그렇지만 그래도 큰일 날 뻔했다, 그런 점에서는 제가 죄송스럽게 생각한다는 마음이 있어요.”)

However, in the video released by Han's side and YouTube footage from different angles, no scene is confirmed where Han’s spokesperson, who was knocked over by the falling cameraman, makes eye contact or communicates verbally with Han immediately after the accident. ( 다만, 한 후보 쪽에서 공개한 영상과 다른 각도에서 찍은 유튜브 영상에서 추락한 카메라 기자와 부딪혀 넘어진 한 후보의 대변인이 사고 직후 한 후보와 눈을 맞추거나 말로 대화를 나누는 장면은 확인되지 않는 상황이다. )

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr ( 이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)
